# Transforming Manufacturing for a Better Future


[Learn more][189]

## The Broadest 3D Printing Portfolio, Built for High-Performance Industries

With deep expertise, we guide you toward smarter, leaner, and more scalable manufacturing.
[A group of 3D Systems 3D Printers]
3D Printers
The industry's most comprehensive range of commercial 3D printers, enabling companies to print
plastic or metal parts at the point-of-need in a fraction of the time compared to traditional
manufacturing processes.
[View all 3D printers][190]
[A group of 3D printed materials]
Materials
Explore our extensive and versatile portfolio of 3D printing materials including plastic, elastomer,
composite, wax, metal, bio-compatible, and more.
[View all materials][191]
[A desktop computer next to a 3D printed part, as shown on the desktop]
Software
Streamline innovation and boost efficiency from design to production with our AI-powered software.
Tailored for precision in additive manufacturing, our software is ideal for industrial and
healthcare applications.
[View our software][192]
[A person holding a 3D printed impeller made from Direct Metal Printing]
Work with our Application Innovation Group
Our dedicated team of application innovation experts guide you from exploration to full-scale
production through a full range of consultative services aimed to help you accelerate and de-risk
adoption of additive.
[Work with our 3D printing experts][193]

[3D Measurement Products][107]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## What You Can Achieve with Our Scanners

Discover the ways in which integrating our scanners into your workflow can enhance efficiency and
help you achieve remarkable results.
* [ Talk to our experts ][131]
* #### Quality Inspection
  
  3D scanners for quality inspection have revolutionized quality control by replacing slow, manual
  gauging with rapid, high-precision automated inspection. This non-destructive testing method
  drastically accelerates inspection cycles, reduces waste, and ensures absolute compliance with
  strict tolerances.
* #### Reverse Engineering
  
  3D scanners make reverse engineering faster and more accurate by converting existing parts and
  prototypes into editable CAD models. This digital workflow preserves precise geometry, simplifies
  redesigns, and helps teams modernize legacy components efficiently.
* #### Digital Archiving & Documentation
  
  3D scanners for digital archiving and documentation are vital for creating flawless, permanent
  digital records of historical artifacts, museum collections, architectural sites and others.
  High-resolution 3D models ensures that history is accurately preserved and globally accessible for
  generations to come.
* #### Product Development & Design
  
  3D scanners for product development and design accelerate the innovation cycle by seamlessly
  transitioning physical concepts into digital workflows. This allows for rapid iteration, complex
  surface modeling, and seamless integration into computer-aided styling (CAS) workflows. By
  capturing real-world geometry instantly, design teams can skip tedious manual measurements, reduce
  time-to-market, and optimize products for both form and function.
* #### Human Body Scanning & Medical Digitization
  
  3D scanners for human body scanning and medical digitization have transformed healthcare by
  creating highly accurate, contact-free 3D models of the human anatomy. 3D scanning technology
  enhances patient comfort, streamlines manufacturing workflows, and elevates personalization in
  patient care.
* #### Research & Education
  
  3D scanners for research and education serve as powerful tools for experiential learning and
  advanced data analysis. In the classroom, they bring abstract concepts to life, allowing students
  in engineering, manufacturing, and archaeology to interact with precise digital replicas of
  complex objects. For researchers, they provide accurate, quantifiable data for geometric analysis,
  product evaluation, and computer simulations.

Core component design technology for cameras, projectors, and wireless computing modules
Integrated opto-mechatronics and computing control system
Real-time stereo reconstruction algorithm for 3D vision
3D geometric modeling, data processing software and certified, customized inspection module
High-accuracy calibration technology for 3D optical measurement

Vicon has been a global leader in motion capture technology for over 40 years. Our award-winning

### MOTION CAPTURE ACROSS A RANGE OF APPLICATIONS

## Motion Capture for Life Sciences

Vicon delivers motion capture solutions for biomechanics, clinical gait analysis, rehabilitation,
sports science, and veterinary research. Our advanced systems capture high-precision kinematics,
seamlessly integrating with force plates, EMG, and biomechanical sensors to produce clean, reliable
datasets for peer-reviewed studies.

With industry-leading accuracy and real-time tracking, Vicon empowers researchers and clinicians to
drive objective treatment planning, optimize performance analysis, and advance movement science.
Trusted globally, Vicon sets the benchmark for transformative life sciences research.

[EXPLORE OUR LIFE SCIENCE SOLUTIONS][80]
[Create AI Studio]

## Motion Capture for Entertainment

Vicon provides state-of-the-art motion capture solutions for film, television, game development, and
immersive experiences, bringing performances to life at the heart of storytelling. Our systems
deliver real-time visualization for directors, high-fidelity mocap data for animators, and
effortless integration with game engines and DCC workflows. Keep stages in sync with sound,
lighting, and playback for seamless collaboration from previsualization to final production.

From dynamic stunts and sprawling crowd scenes to nuanced dialogue, Vicon streamlines production,
minimizes rework, and ensures unparalleled creative precision for captivating, authentic results.

[EXPLORE OUR ENTERTAINMENT SOLUTIONS][81]

## Vicon Motion Capture for Engineering

Vicon delivers advanced motion capture systems for robotics, drones, and autonomous vehicles,
providing high-precision, low-latency tracking of position and orientation in real time. Engineers
rely on Vicon to validate designs, conduct precise testing, and enhance performance throughout
development cycles.

Scalable from compact benchtop setups to expansive flight labs and large-scale test arenas, Vicon
ensures consistent, reproducible data, minimizing development risks and accelerating time to
deployment for cutting-edge autonomous technologies.

[EXPLORE OUR ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS][82]

## Markerless

Vicon’s markerless motion capture technology delivers precise, real-time tracking without suits or
physical markers, revolutionizing motion capture for the entertainment industry. Tailored for
virtual production, video games, live events, and digital character animation, it captures authentic
human movement with unparalleled ease.

Seamlessly integrating into production pipelines, Vicon Markerless provides high-fidelity motion
data, slashing setup time and boosting creative freedom for performers and production teams.
Scalable and reliable, it empowers studios, game developers, and live entertainment projects with
fast, reproducible results for stunning, production-ready outcomes.

[EXPLORE MARKERLESS][83]

# AWARD WINNING MOTION CAPTURE SYSTEMS

*Motion capture for life sciences, entertainment, and engineering — trusted worldwide for accuracy,

Vicon has been a global leader in motion capture technology for over 40 years. Our award-winning
systems combine **optical and markerless motion capture, inertial tracking, and VR solutions** to
deliver the most accurate tools for capturing and analyzing movement. We specialize in **motion
capture for life sciences, entertainment, and engineering**, enabling researchers, creators, and
innovators to measure, understand, and bring motion to life.

### MOTION CAPTURE ACROSS A RANGE OF APPLICATIONS

## Motion Capture for Life Sciences

Vicon delivers motion capture solutions for biomechanics, clinical gait analysis, rehabilitation,
sports science, and veterinary research. Our advanced systems capture high-precision kinematics,
seamlessly integrating with force plates, EMG, and biomechanical sensors to produce clean, reliable
datasets for peer-reviewed studies.

With industry-leading accuracy and real-time tracking, Vicon empowers researchers and clinicians to
drive objective treatment planning, optimize performance analysis, and advance movement science.
Trusted globally, Vicon sets the benchmark for transformative life sciences research.

[EXPLORE OUR LIFE SCIENCE SOLUTIONS][80]
[Create AI Studio]

## Motion Capture for Entertainment

Vicon provides state-of-the-art motion capture solutions for film, television, game development, and
immersive experiences, bringing performances to life at the heart of storytelling. Our systems
deliver real-time visualization for directors, high-fidelity mocap data for animators, and
effortless integration with game engines and DCC workflows. Keep stages in sync with sound,
lighting, and playback for seamless collaboration from previsualization to final production.

From dynamic stunts and sprawling crowd scenes to nuanced dialogue, Vicon streamlines production,
minimizes rework, and ensures unparalleled creative precision for captivating, authentic results.

[EXPLORE OUR ENTERTAINMENT SOLUTIONS][81]

## Vicon Motion Capture for Engineering

Vicon delivers advanced motion capture systems for robotics, drones, and autonomous vehicles,
providing high-precision, low-latency tracking of position and orientation in real time. Engineers
rely on Vicon to validate designs, conduct precise testing, and enhance performance throughout
development cycles.

Scalable from compact benchtop setups to expansive flight labs and large-scale test arenas, Vicon
ensures consistent, reproducible data, minimizing development risks and accelerating time to
deployment for cutting-edge autonomous technologies.

[EXPLORE OUR ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS][82]

## Markerless

Vicon’s markerless motion capture technology delivers precise, real-time tracking without suits or
physical markers, revolutionizing motion capture for the entertainment industry. Tailored for
virtual production, video games, live events, and digital character animation, it captures authentic
human movement with unparalleled ease.

Seamlessly integrating into production pipelines, Vicon Markerless provides high-fidelity motion
data, slashing setup time and boosting creative freedom for performers and production teams.
Scalable and reliable, it empowers studios, game developers, and live entertainment projects with
fast, reproducible results for stunning, production-ready outcomes.

[EXPLORE MARKERLESS][83]

# Coming Soon

[[3DScanningAlliance.com serves as the official hub of The 3D Scanning Alliance, connecting global
vendors, studios, and innovators in 3D capture, photogrammetry, and lidar technology. The platform
provides membership access, vendor certification, and international collaboration opportunities for
professionals at every level. It represents the unifying vision of the Alliance; to create global
standards for accuracy, education, and innovation in 3D scanning. From Los Angeles to London, this
is where the world’s 3D scanning professionals come together.]][1]
[

# THE GLOBAL 3D SCANNING HUB & COMMUNITY

][2]

[**3DScanHub.com**][3] is part of [*The 3D Scanning Alliance*][4], powered by [3dscanning.com][5]
the global network connecting professionals in photogrammetry, lidar, laser, and AI-driven
reconstruction.
As the operational center of the Alliance, [**3D Scan Hub** ][6]functions as the **collaboration and
communication platform** for 3D scanning professionals, vendors, researchers, and clients worldwide.
It’s where education, technology, and opportunity intersect empowering the industry to share,
connect, and grow together.

# [ABOUT ****][7]**[THE 3D SCANNING ALLIANCE][8]**

The [**3D Scanning Alliance**][9] unites global scanning professionals, researchers, and creators
under a shared mission to elevate the art and science of digital capture. From vendor onboarding to
workflow optimization, the Alliance ensures that every scan produced under its banner represents the
highest standard of accuracy, integrity, and innovation.
Through [**3DScanHub.com**][10], that mission becomes actionable empowering collaboration, growth,
and advancement across every region and discipline.

# FOUNDATION OF THE 3D SCANNING ALLIANCE

If you are a **Vendor**, **Developer**, or **Organization** interested in joining **[*The 3D
Scanning Alliance*][11],** or a **client** seeking to connect with certified professionals, we
invite you to connect directly.


Our **Membership Portal**, **Vendor Directory**, and **Resource Library** are coming soon providing
seamless access to everything the global scanning community needs in one place. **[*The 3D Scanning
Alliance*][12]**continues to empower professionals through innovation, education, and unity all
connected through **[3DScanHub.com][13].**

Great ideas for tomorrow!

## 事業案内

Arcana製作所で行っている事業のご案内です。

1

### FacTrans フルカラー3Dスキャナー


フルカラー3Dスキャナー
FacTransシリーズの製品開発・販売を行っております。従来のスキャナーで難しかったオブジェクトをスキャン
が可能です。デスクトップタイプのスキャナーから全身スキャナーまでラインナップしています。

[詳しく見る][32]

2

### 3Dスキャナー開発


フォトグラメトリー技術を使用したフルカラーの3Dスキャナーの開発を行っています。被写体に合わせカメラ、
照明の選定を行います。

[詳しく見る][33]

3

### CNCルーター、コントローラー


X,Y,Zの3軸加工機やCNCルーターの製品開発・販売を行っております。様々なニーズに合わせたカスタマイズ・
レトロフィットも可能です。EdingCNCの正規ディーラーとしてコントローラーの販売も行っております。

[詳しく見る][34]

4

### インクジェットプリンター用治具、自動化装置


UVインクジェットプリンターや産業用インクジェットプリンターをロボットなどを活用し自動化する装置の設計
、前後装置との連携やワークを固定する為の治具設計を行っております。

[詳しく見る][35]

5

### 受託開発・自動化装置


メカ設計、電気設計、ファームウェア、ソフトウェア、シングルボードコンピューターシステムの受託開発を行
っています。IoT技術を応用した見える化システム、ロボットを活用した自動化設計も行っています。

[詳しく見る][36]

## **Arcana製作所**

Great ideas for tomorrow!

## 事業案内

Arcana製作所で行っている事業のご案内です。

1

### FacTrans フルカラー3Dスキャナー


フルカラー3Dスキャナー
FacTransシリーズの製品開発・販売を行っております。従来のスキャナーで難しかったオブジェクトをスキャン
が可能です。デスクトップタイプのスキャナーから全身スキャナーまでラインナップしています。

[詳しく見る][32]

2

### 3Dスキャナー開発


フォトグラメトリー技術を使用したフルカラーの3Dスキャナーの開発を行っています。被写体に合わせカメラ、
照明の選定を行います。

[詳しく見る][33]

3

### CNCルーター、コントローラー


X,Y,Zの3軸加工機やCNCルーターの製品開発・販売を行っております。様々なニーズに合わせたカスタマイズ・
レトロフィットも可能です。EdingCNCの正規ディーラーとしてコントローラーの販売も行っております。

[詳しく見る][34]

4

### インクジェットプリンター用治具、自動化装置


UVインクジェットプリンターや産業用インクジェットプリンターをロボットなどを活用し自動化する装置の設計
、前後装置との連携やワークを固定する為の治具設計を行っております。

[詳しく見る][35]

5

### 受託開発・自動化装置


メカ設計、電気設計、ファームウェア、ソフトウェア、シングルボードコンピューターシステムの受託開発を行
っています。IoT技術を応用した見える化システム、ロボットを活用した自動化設計も行っています。

[詳しく見る][36]

## **Arcana製作所**

Great ideas for tomorrow!

## 事業案内

Arcana製作所で行っている事業のご案内です。

1

### FacTrans フルカラー3Dスキャナー


フルカラー3Dスキャナー
FacTransシリーズの製品開発・販売を行っております。従来のスキャナーで難しかったオブジェクトをスキャン
が可能です。デスクトップタイプのスキャナーから全身スキャナーまでラインナップしています。

[詳しく見る][32]

2

### 3Dスキャナー開発


フォトグラメトリー技術を使用したフルカラーの3Dスキャナーの開発を行っています。被写体に合わせカメラ、
照明の選定を行います。

[詳しく見る][33]

3

### CNCルーター、コントローラー


X,Y,Zの3軸加工機やCNCルーターの製品開発・販売を行っております。様々なニーズに合わせたカスタマイズ・
レトロフィットも可能です。EdingCNCの正規ディーラーとしてコントローラーの販売も行っております。

[詳しく見る][34]

4

### インクジェットプリンター用治具、自動化装置


UVインクジェットプリンターや産業用インクジェットプリンターをロボットなどを活用し自動化する装置の設計
、前後装置との連携やワークを固定する為の治具設計を行っております。

[詳しく見る][35]

5

### 受託開発・自動化装置


メカ設計、電気設計、ファームウェア、ソフトウェア、シングルボードコンピューターシステムの受託開発を行
っています。IoT技術を応用した見える化システム、ロボットを活用した自動化設計も行っています。

[詳しく見る][36]

Long Range 3D Laser Scanning for Large-Scale Projects

# Nationwide 3D Laser Scanning Company

Arrival 3D is a dedicated **3D laser scanning company** delivering millimeter-accurate point clouds,
Revit BIM models, and CAD drawings for architecture, engineering, and construction across all 50
states. Explore our full 3D laser scanning services or speak with our team today.

## 3D Laser Scanning Company Built for Projects with No Margin for Error

Arrival 3D is a dedicated 3D laser scanning company serving clients **nationwide across all 50
states**. We’ve completed **10,000+ projects** and bring over 20 years of experience delivering
accurate site data, BIM models, CAD drawings, and digital assets for commercial, industrial, data
centers, school, hospital, oil and gas facilities, and infrastructure projects.

Using Leica RTC360, Leica P-Series, NavVis VLX, and drone-based LiDAR [technology][202], we capture
existing conditions and create as-built documentation. We also deliver digital twins that serve as a
virtual replica or reliable digital record of a facility, supporting virtual tours, asset
management, operational planning, and future renovations.

**What Sets Arrival 3D Apart**
* Unlike surveying and engineering firms, high-precision 3D scanning is our core specialty.
* In-house team of Leica-certified technicians, PMP-certified project managers on every project, and
  Scan to BIM specialists with 10+ years of hands-on experience.
* Annually calibrated equipment with mandatory QA/QC
* Accuracy as precise as ±1 mm exceeding the typical industry range of 2–6 mm
* Fixed-price proposals within 48 hours and typical delivery within 10 days
* Structural scanning and deviation reporting to ±1mm tolerance
* Building condition assessments for capital planning and insurance

So, whether the project is a single-room renovation or a 130-site nationwide program, Arrival 3D
delivers ultra-accurate 3D scanning solutions backed by a dedicated point of contact from start to
finish.

[ Read More About Us ][203]

Our core service is millimeter-accurate LiDAR capture of buildings, facilities, and infrastructure.
Point clouds, BIM models and CAD drawings delivered natiowide.

### Scan to BIM Services

Convert point cloud data directly into intelligent 3D BIM models for Architecture, Engineering &
Construction projects, enabling clash detection, quantity take-offs, and accurate design.

[Digital Twin Services - Arrival 3D]

### Digital Twin + Live Integration

Develop comprehensive digital twins for facilities, assets, and infrastructure, enabling online
collaborative walk-through environments  with data integration

### Industrial 3D Laser Scanning

Update as-built records of power plants, oil & gas refineries,  factories and other industrial

[2D Floor Plan Services - Arrival 3D]

### Scan to CAD / Floor Plans

Accurate 2D floor plans, sections, elevations and site drawings dimensioned from point cloud data.
DWG, DXF, PDF delivery.

### Facility Management Scanning

Provide 3D Revit models that are optimized for facility management and containing appropriate

Quickly capture large or difficult-to-reach areas using drones and receive point clouds, color topo

[MEP BIM Services - Arrival 3D]

### MEP & Above-Ceiling Scanning

Precise capture of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems above ceilings and in congested
plant rooms. Every pipe, duct, and conduit located in 3D before your engineers design against it.

[ MEP scanning Services ][211]
[As Built Plans Arrival 3D]

### As Built Documentation

Capture highly detailed and precise as-built 3D models of your building or facility along with color
panoramic photos of the site for thorough as-built documentation

[ As-Built Documentation Service ][212]

#### Why Use 3D Laser Scanning?

## Precise 3D Laser Scanning with CAD & BIM Models You Can Use Immediately

[Arrival 3D - 3D laser Scanning services]

##### Nothing is More Accurate Than 3D Laser Scanning

Our Leica RTC360 scanners calibrated by us every year capture millions of data points per scan at
**±1mm accuracy**. The typical industry range is 2–6mm. That gap matters: on a refinery retrofit or
a hospital above-ceiling, a 5mm error means rework. A 1mm scan means it fits the first time.

Every project ships with a structured QA/QC check before the file leaves our hands. Not a visual
glance, but a systematic review against the raw scan data.

##### No site shutdown. No contact. No guesswork.

3D laser scanning is non-intrusive and contactless your facility keeps running while we work.
Hazardous areas, high ceilings, confined spaces, refinery piping, structural voids: all documented
safely from a distance, without putting anyone at risk.

Our Leica RTC360 captures a full scan in under 2 minutes and pre-registers on-site as we go so by
the time we leave your facility, the data is already aligned and verified. Registered point clouds
delivered within 2–3 days of scanning. Final deliverables in ~10 days.

##### BIM & CAD Deliverables You Can Use Immediately

We provide ready-to-use digital 3D models deliverables tailored to your workflows. We generate
native CAD and BIM models in platforms like Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks and SolidWorks, as

# Nationwide 3D Laser Scanning Company

Arrival 3D is a dedicated **3D laser scanning company** delivering millimeter-accurate point clouds,
Revit BIM models, and CAD drawings for architecture, engineering, and construction across all 50
states. Explore our full 3D laser scanning services or speak with our team today.

## 3D Laser Scanning Company Built for Projects with No Margin for Error

Arrival 3D is a dedicated 3D laser scanning company serving clients **nationwide across all 50
states**. We’ve completed **10,000+ projects** and bring over 20 years of experience delivering
accurate site data, BIM models, CAD drawings, and digital assets for commercial, industrial, data
centers, school, hospital, oil and gas facilities, and infrastructure projects.

Using Leica RTC360, Leica P-Series, NavVis VLX, and drone-based LiDAR [technology][202], we capture
existing conditions and create as-built documentation. We also deliver digital twins that serve as a
virtual replica or reliable digital record of a facility, supporting virtual tours, asset
management, operational planning, and future renovations.

**What Sets Arrival 3D Apart**
* Unlike surveying and engineering firms, high-precision 3D scanning is our core specialty.
* In-house team of Leica-certified technicians, PMP-certified project managers on every project, and
  Scan to BIM specialists with 10+ years of hands-on experience.
* Annually calibrated equipment with mandatory QA/QC
* Accuracy as precise as ±1 mm exceeding the typical industry range of 2–6 mm
* Fixed-price proposals within 48 hours and typical delivery within 10 days
* Structural scanning and deviation reporting to ±1mm tolerance
* Building condition assessments for capital planning and insurance

So, whether the project is a single-room renovation or a 130-site nationwide program, Arrival 3D
delivers ultra-accurate 3D scanning solutions backed by a dedicated point of contact from start to
finish.

## Precise 3D Laser Scanning with CAD & BIM Models You Can Use Immediately

##### Nothing is More Accurate Than 3D Laser Scanning

Our Leica RTC360 scanners calibrated by us every year capture millions of data points per scan at
**±1mm accuracy**. The typical industry range is 2–6mm. That gap matters: on a refinery retrofit or
a hospital above-ceiling, a 5mm error means rework. A 1mm scan means it fits the first time.

Every project ships with a structured QA/QC check before the file leaves our hands. Not a visual
glance, but a systematic review against the raw scan data.

##### No site shutdown. No contact. No guesswork.

3D laser scanning is non-intrusive and contactless your facility keeps running while we work.
Hazardous areas, high ceilings, confined spaces, refinery piping, structural voids: all documented
safely from a distance, without putting anyone at risk.

Our Leica RTC360 captures a full scan in under 2 minutes and pre-registers on-site as we go so by
the time we leave your facility, the data is already aligned and verified. Registered point clouds
delivered within 2–3 days of scanning. Final deliverables in ~10 days.

FAQ

## Common questions about 3D scanning

### What is point cloud scanning?

Point cloud scanning, also called 3D laser scanning or LiDAR survey, captures millions of measured
points across a site to build an accurate 3D record of what is really there. A laser scanner records
the exact position of every surface it can see. The result is a point cloud you can measure, model,
and share. It replaces slow hand measurement and removes guesswork from existing-condition data for
architects, engineers, and builders.

### How much does 3D laser scanning cost?

A single-floor commercial space under 500m2 typically starts around $1,500 to $2,500 for a point
cloud deliverable. Cost depends on site size, complexity, and the deliverables you need, such as BIM
models or CAD drawings. We give a fixed-price quote before any site visit, so there are no hourly
rates and no surprises. Use our online pricing calculator for an instant estimate, or contact us for
a tailored quote.

### LiDAR vs photogrammetry: what is the difference?

LiDAR uses laser pulses to measure distance and build a 3D point cloud directly. It works in any
lighting and delivers millimetre-level accuracy, so we use it for building interiors and precision
work. Photogrammetry reconstructs 3D geometry from overlapping photographs and produces colour-rich
models that suit aerial mapping, facades, and textured surfaces. For large-area aerial survey and
visual documentation, photogrammetry is often more cost-effective. We choose the right method for
your project.

### How accurate is 3D laser scanning?

Our Trimble X7 and Trimble X9 terrestrial scanners capture individual points at +/-2mm at ranges up
to 80 metres. After registration and survey control to AHD and MGA2020, network accuracy is
typically +/-5mm across a whole building. Aerial LiDAR sits at about +/-30mm vertical at independent
check points. This exceeds BIM LOD 300 requirements and suits renovation design, structural
assessment, and heritage records. Every project ships with an accuracy report.

### What is scan to BIM?

Scan to BIM is the process of turning a point cloud into a Revit, ArchiCAD, or IFC model of an
existing building. We scan the site, register the data, then model walls, floors, structure, and
services to your specified Level of Detail, usually LOD 200 to LOD 400. The result is a coordinated
3D model design teams can work in directly. We accept point cloud data from any scanner if you
already have a scan.

FAQ

## Common questions about 3D scanning

### What is point cloud scanning?

Point cloud scanning, also called 3D laser scanning or LiDAR survey, captures millions of measured
points across a site to build an accurate 3D record of what is really there. A laser scanner records
the exact position of every surface it can see. The result is a point cloud you can measure, model,
and share. It replaces slow hand measurement and removes guesswork from existing-condition data for
architects, engineers, and builders.

### How much does 3D laser scanning cost?

A single-floor commercial space under 500m2 typically starts around $1,500 to $2,500 for a point
cloud deliverable. Cost depends on site size, complexity, and the deliverables you need, such as BIM
models or CAD drawings. We give a fixed-price quote before any site visit, so there are no hourly
rates and no surprises. Use our online pricing calculator for an instant estimate, or contact us for
a tailored quote.

### LiDAR vs photogrammetry: what is the difference?

LiDAR uses laser pulses to measure distance and build a 3D point cloud directly. It works in any
lighting and delivers millimetre-level accuracy, so we use it for building interiors and precision
work. Photogrammetry reconstructs 3D geometry from overlapping photographs and produces colour-rich
models that suit aerial mapping, facades, and textured surfaces. For large-area aerial survey and
visual documentation, photogrammetry is often more cost-effective. We choose the right method for
your project.

### How accurate is 3D laser scanning?

Our Trimble X7 and Trimble X9 terrestrial scanners capture individual points at +/-2mm at ranges up
to 80 metres. After registration and survey control to AHD and MGA2020, network accuracy is
typically +/-5mm across a whole building. Aerial LiDAR sits at about +/-30mm vertical at independent
check points. This exceeds BIM LOD 300 requirements and suits renovation design, structural
assessment, and heritage records. Every project ships with an accuracy report.

### What is scan to BIM?

Scan to BIM is the process of turning a point cloud into a Revit, ArchiCAD, or IFC model of an
existing building. We scan the site, register the data, then model walls, floors, structure, and
services to your specified Level of Detail, usually LOD 200 to LOD 400. The result is a coordinated
3D model design teams can work in directly. We accept point cloud data from any scanner if you
already have a scan.

# The expertise
# to take it on

## Unsere Services

### ENGINEERING

Du bringst die Idee – wir liefern das Engineering dahinter. Ob CAD-Modellbau, parametrisches Reverse
Engineering oder smarte Simulationen mit Augmented Reality – unser Know-how ist so vielseitig wie
deine Anforderungen.Diese Mischung macht uns flexibel: Wir entwickeln individuelle, praxisnahe
Lösungen, die nicht nur auf dem Bildschirm überzeugen, sondern bereit für die Umsetzung sind.
[ Hier klicken ][90]

### Design

Dein Produkt soll mehr können als nur funktionieren? Unser dynamisches Design-Team vereint
Kreativität mit technischem Know-how. Egal ob Produkt-, Textildesign oder ganzheitliche Konzepte –
wir denken Design von Anfang an mit. Farben, Materialien und Oberflächen setzen wir gezielt ein, um
deinem Produkt Charakter, Qualität und Wiedererkennungswert zu verleihen. Auch Nachhaltigkeit ist
für uns kein Trend, sondern ein fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit.
[ Hier klicken ][91]

### Fertigung

Du brauchst nicht nur eine Idee, sondern auch die Umsetzung? Kein Problem – mit unserem eigenen
Produktionsteam bringen wir deine Lösung direkt in die Realität. Durch unsere Erfahrung in
unterschiedlichsten Branchen entwickeln wir ganzheitliche Ansätze für komplexe Anforderungen – zum
Beispiel beim Bau von industriellen Testmodellen oder innovativen Prototypen, die genau auf dein
Projekt zugeschnitten sind.
[ Hier klicken ][92]

### 3D Scan

Präzision, auf den Punkt gescannt. Mit unserem erfahrenen Team und modernster Scan-Technik erstellen
wir hochpräzise 3D-Scans – perfekt abgestimmt auf deine Anforderungen. Die exakten Messdaten bilden
die Grundlage für hochwertige Modelle und sorgen dafür, dass du Zeit und Kosten im Projekt sparst –
ganz ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität.
[ Hier klicken ][93]

## Deine Herausforderung - unser Ansatz

Wir sind ein buntes Team mit klarem Fokus: Zukunft machen.
Umwelt im Blick, Technik und Design im Herzen und jede Menge Ideen im Kopf – wir entwickeln
maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die passen. Ob großes Projekt oder knifflige Herausforderung – wir denken
mit, weiter und voraus. Und zwar von Anfang bis Ende.

wir hochpräzise 3D-Scans – perfekt abgestimmt auf deine Anforderungen. Die exakten Messdaten bilden
die Grundlage für hochwertige Modelle und sorgen dafür, dass du Zeit und Kosten im Projekt sparst –
ganz ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität.
[ Hier klicken ][93]

## Deine Herausforderung - unser Ansatz

Wir sind ein buntes Team mit klarem Fokus: Zukunft machen.
Umwelt im Blick, Technik und Design im Herzen und jede Menge Ideen im Kopf – wir entwickeln
maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die passen. Ob großes Projekt oder knifflige Herausforderung – wir denken
mit, weiter und voraus. Und zwar von Anfang bis Ende.

# The expertise
# to take it on

## Unsere Services

### ENGINEERING

Du bringst die Idee – wir liefern das Engineering dahinter. Ob CAD-Modellbau, parametrisches Reverse
Engineering oder smarte Simulationen mit Augmented Reality – unser Know-how ist so vielseitig wie
deine Anforderungen.Diese Mischung macht uns flexibel: Wir entwickeln individuelle, praxisnahe
Lösungen, die nicht nur auf dem Bildschirm überzeugen, sondern bereit für die Umsetzung sind.
[ Hier klicken ][90]

### Design

Dein Produkt soll mehr können als nur funktionieren? Unser dynamisches Design-Team vereint
Kreativität mit technischem Know-how. Egal ob Produkt-, Textildesign oder ganzheitliche Konzepte –
wir denken Design von Anfang an mit. Farben, Materialien und Oberflächen setzen wir gezielt ein, um
deinem Produkt Charakter, Qualität und Wiedererkennungswert zu verleihen. Auch Nachhaltigkeit ist
für uns kein Trend, sondern ein fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit.
[ Hier klicken ][91]

### Fertigung

Du brauchst nicht nur eine Idee, sondern auch die Umsetzung? Kein Problem – mit unserem eigenen
Produktionsteam bringen wir deine Lösung direkt in die Realität. Durch unsere Erfahrung in
unterschiedlichsten Branchen entwickeln wir ganzheitliche Ansätze für komplexe Anforderungen – zum
Beispiel beim Bau von industriellen Testmodellen oder innovativen Prototypen, die genau auf dein
Projekt zugeschnitten sind.
[ Hier klicken ][92]

### 3D Scan

Präzision, auf den Punkt gescannt. Mit unserem erfahrenen Team und modernster Scan-Technik erstellen
wir hochpräzise 3D-Scans – perfekt abgestimmt auf deine Anforderungen. Die exakten Messdaten bilden
die Grundlage für hochwertige Modelle und sorgen dafür, dass du Zeit und Kosten im Projekt sparst –
ganz ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität.
[ Hier klicken ][93]

## Deine Herausforderung - unser Ansatz

Wir sind ein buntes Team mit klarem Fokus: Zukunft machen.
Umwelt im Blick, Technik und Design im Herzen und jede Menge Ideen im Kopf – wir entwickeln
maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die passen. Ob großes Projekt oder knifflige Herausforderung – wir denken
mit, weiter und voraus. Und zwar von Anfang bis Ende.

Discover the latest AI-driven products from Cognex, designed to solve automation challenges with
high accuracy and ease of use.

[Download Product Guide][7]
[Cognex In-Sight 3900 Vision System]

High-speed AI-powered inspections, no trade-offs. Inspect more features, make decisions faster, and
keep production moving with the In-Sight 3900.

[Meet the In-Sight 3900][8]

Catch errors early and verify every component with automated assembly inspection.

[Confidence]

[Visibility]

### Total Inspection

100% of product inspected 

[Checkmark]

### Remarkable Accuracy

[Confidence]

[See full story][20]

[Fast speed]

fatigue, handling natural variations, and providing predictive insights that transform quality
control from reactive to proactive.

## [Precision & Innovation With 3D Scanning][100]

Central Scanning stands at the forefront of 3D technology, offering services in **[3D
Scanning][101]**, **[3D Printing][102]**, and [**3D Inspection**][103] across all industries. From
groundbreaking aerospace engineering to meticulous medical applications, our solutions are designed
to propel your projects to new heights.

Featuring industry-leading names like [Geomagic Design X][106], [Geomagic for
SOLIDWORKS][107], [Geomagic Control X][108], [ZEISS Quality Suite][109], [Artec
Studio][110], [SpaceClaim][111], and many more, we ensure that you get access to the most advanced
functionalities tailored to your specific applications.

Get the most accurate 3D models of your small or large objects with our reverse engineering service.
We can provide you with various scanning applications including models for manufacturing, healthcare
applications, and industrial design.

# Our 3D Scanning Services

 

Our suite of services goes beyond scanning. Dive into Inspection, Reverse Engineering, 3D Printing,
and tailored Training sessions. Plus, as the official UK resellers of ARTEC 3D and ZEISS, we’re here
to guide you from pre-sales to post-support.



#### 3D Scanners for Sale

The heart of our expertise.

As proud UK resellers for ZEISS and Artec 3D, we offer an extensive selection of 3D scanners perfect
for applications large and small.



#### 3D Scanning

Experience precision with our advanced metrology and reverse engineering services, leveraging Laser,
Blue Light, and CT Scanning for any project size.



#### 3D Printing

Rapid, accurate reproductions using Polyjet Multi Colour Materials & FDM Technologies to bring your
visions to life. Serving a spectrum of industries with agility and precision.



#### Reverse Engineering

Transform point cloud/STL data into precise CAD surfaces and solid models with our expert reverse
engineering services, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in your design process.



#### 3D Inspection

Ensure the utmost accuracy with our inspection services, comparing 3D scan data directly against CAD
models or other scan data for precise quality assurance.



#### Training

Empower your team with our expert-led training on ZEISS 3D scanning, Artec Studio, and more,
ensuring you maximise your technology investment.

[Browse Our Services][136]

### Why Choose Us?
* **Expert Guidance:** Our knowledgeable team is here to advise on the best fit for your specific
  needs, ensuring optimal outcomes for your projects.
* **Comprehensive Support:** From initial consultation to post-purchase training and support,
  Central Scanning stands by your side every step of the way.
* **Versatile Applications:** Catering to a broad range of industries, including aerospace,
  automotive, medical, and creative arts, our solutions are as diverse as the sectors we serve.

Dive into the world of advanced 3D scanning with HandsOnMetrology, our expert partner network, and

# Our 3D Scanning Services

 

Our suite of services goes beyond scanning. Dive into Inspection, Reverse Engineering, 3D Printing,
and tailored Training sessions. Plus, as the official UK resellers of ARTEC 3D and ZEISS, we’re here
to guide you from pre-sales to post-support.



#### 3D Scanners for Sale

The heart of our expertise.

As proud UK resellers for ZEISS and Artec 3D, we offer an extensive selection of 3D scanners perfect
for applications large and small.



#### 3D Scanning

Experience precision with our advanced metrology and reverse engineering services, leveraging Laser,
Blue Light, and CT Scanning for any project size.



#### 3D Printing

Rapid, accurate reproductions using Polyjet Multi Colour Materials & FDM Technologies to bring your
visions to life. Serving a spectrum of industries with agility and precision.



#### Reverse Engineering

Transform point cloud/STL data into precise CAD surfaces and solid models with our expert reverse
engineering services, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in your design process.



#### 3D Inspection

Ensure the utmost accuracy with our inspection services, comparing 3D scan data directly against CAD
models or other scan data for precise quality assurance.



#### Training

Empower your team with our expert-led training on ZEISS 3D scanning, Artec Studio, and more,
ensuring you maximise your technology investment.

[Browse Our Services][136]

### Why Choose Us?
* **Expert Guidance:** Our knowledgeable team is here to advise on the best fit for your specific
  needs, ensuring optimal outcomes for your projects.
* **Comprehensive Support:** From initial consultation to post-purchase training and support,
  Central Scanning stands by your side every step of the way.
* **Versatile Applications:** Catering to a broad range of industries, including aerospace,
  automotive, medical, and creative arts, our solutions are as diverse as the sectors we serve.

Dive into the world of advanced 3D scanning with HandsOnMetrology, our expert partner network, and
enhance your scanning projects.

The best part? The model is easy to resize for any pet, and the prints are lightweight, so they’re

[creality k2 pro 3d printer model]

#### @Unboxtherapy[[youtube logo img]][117]

Printed with K2 Pro

This is the Creality K2 Pro 3D printer. See how the Creality K2 Pro brings oddly satisfying 3D
printed creations to life — smooth, colorful, and precise, layer by layer.

[3d print Rotary Cannon]

#### @Polskihussar[[instagram logo img]][118]

Printed with K2 Plus

Maximizing size and color with the Creality K2 Plus! Here’s my build of the iconic Rotary Cannon
from the Clone Wars — detailed, vibrant, and ready for display.

[3d print TEMPLE BOX]

#### @Af_inventions[[instagram logo img]][119]

Printed with K2 Plus

TEMPLE BOX 🏛️ | Inspired by the temple of 3000 years ago, enhanced with incredible details,
textures, and beauty — reimagined into the temple of 1500 years ago and the temple of today! To
emphasize all the details in this model, I used the Creality K2 Plus.

## Media Reviews

The Creality Ender 3 V3 SE sets a new baseline for cheap 3D printing, blending a familiar form with
the beginner-friendly fully automatic bed leveling and self-offsetting, giving effortlessly perfect
first layers.

###### Matthew Mensley

ALL3DP

[All3dp logo]

My experience from unboxing through to print completion was enjoyable and seamless. With the printer
needing only several screws to connect and wiring connections, this printer would be accessible for
all users, from inexperienced to experienced 3D hobbyists.

###### 3DWithUs

3DWithUs

[3DWithUs logo]

The Creality K2 Plus is a fully enclosed Core XY powerhouse machine. It includes multiple sensors
for excellent bed leveling and two AI-driven cameras for monitoring prints.

###### Denise Bertacchi

Tom's HARDWARE

[Tom's HARDWARE logo]

What you're getting here is a printer that steps into the next generation of 3D printing, offering
even more options, making it one of the de facto best 3D printers I've tested for professionals as
well as for education.

###### Alastair Jennings

TechRadar

[TechRadar logo]

“Your dreams in color come true” as the K2 Plus x CFS Combo hits the shelve on November 11. Unifying
multicolor, speed, intelligence, and a 350mm cubed format in one, the 3D printer combo is the
ultimate evolution of the esteemed K series and the next-level powerhouse for pros and hobbyists.

## Media Reviews

The Creality Ender 3 V3 SE sets a new baseline for cheap 3D printing, blending a familiar form with
the beginner-friendly fully automatic bed leveling and self-offsetting, giving effortlessly perfect
first layers.

###### Matthew Mensley

ALL3DP

[All3dp logo]

My experience from unboxing through to print completion was enjoyable and seamless. With the printer
needing only several screws to connect and wiring connections, this printer would be accessible for
all users, from inexperienced to experienced 3D hobbyists.

###### 3DWithUs

3DWithUs

[3DWithUs logo]

The Creality K2 Plus is a fully enclosed Core XY powerhouse machine. It includes multiple sensors
for excellent bed leveling and two AI-driven cameras for monitoring prints.

###### Denise Bertacchi

Tom's HARDWARE

[Tom's HARDWARE logo]

What you're getting here is a printer that steps into the next generation of 3D printing, offering
even more options, making it one of the de facto best 3D printers I've tested for professionals as
well as for education.

TechRadar

“Your dreams in color come true” as the K2 Plus x CFS Combo hits the shelve on November 11. Unifying
multicolor, speed, intelligence, and a 350mm cubed format in one, the 3D printer combo is the
ultimate evolution of the esteemed K series and the next-level powerhouse for pros and hobbyists.

Our scanning accuracy ranges from 0.0003” (0.01mm) to 0.004” (0.1mm). We have a very fast turnaround
time depending on the complexity of a project. Usually, we guarantee 24 to 72 hours.

#### Some Scanners used for Service Work

To obtain the best quality scan, we consider the size, color, and reflectivity of the object. We
have the capability to scan objects as small as a thumb print and as large as a semi-truck. Some of
our 3D Scanners capture color at the highest resolution of up to 10 microns (0.0003”). We will
recommend the best 3D scanning solutions for your application. For more Information, **[Please
Contact us.][52]**

✕
3D LASER-
SCANNING 3D-Laserscans generieren eine hochpräzise Bestands-
dokumentation und sind verlässliche, digitale Basis
für Planung, Analyse und Zusammenarbeit.
Neben Teilbereichen digitalisieren wir zunehmend
komplette Standorte mit Flächen über 100.000 m².
Die Ergebnisse sind virtuelle Rundgänge,
CAD-optimierte Punktwolken sowie CAD- und
BIM Modelle. [Mehr erfahren ][13] GANZHEITLICHE
PROJEKTENT-
WICKLUNG Ganzheitliche Projektentwicklung - von Beginn an:
Wir integrieren das BIM-Gebäudemodell Ihres Planungs-
büros, erstellen 3D-Modelle Ihrer Maschinen und
Anlagen und entwickeln gemeinsam mit Ihnen,
Ihren Fachabteilungen sowie Architekten und
Bauträgern ein konsistentes, aufeinander
abgestimmtes 3D-Gesamtmodell Ihres zukünftigen
Produktionsstandortes. [Mehr erfahren ][14] PROJEKT-
MANAGEMENT
& CONSULTING Jahrzehntelange Erfahrung in der laserbasierten
Bestandsdigitalisierung, im Projektmanagement
sowie in der partnerschaftlichen Beratung bilden
unseren Mehrwert für Sie. Profitieren Sie
von einer professionellen Konzeption ganzheitlicher
Lösungskonzepte. Wir begleiten Sie zuverlässig
in jeder Projektphase. [Mehr erfahren ][15] CAD
BESTANDS-
MODELLE Je nach Bedarf erhalten Sie 2D- oder 3D-Layouts
Ihrer Produktionshallen, Maschinen, Anlagen,
Verkehrswege, Lagerflächen sowie Energie- und
Medienversorgung – für Ihre eigene Planung
oder als projektrelevante Bestandsdaten für die
Projekte, die Sie für Ihre Kunden realisieren. [Mehr erfahren ][16] BIM
BESTANDS-
MODELLE Projekte im Bestand: Wir erstellen auf der Basis
der 3D Laserscans das BIM-Bestands-Gebäudemodell.
Durch die frühzeitige Prüfung der anlagentechnischen
und baulichen Schnittstellen lassen sich notwendige
Anpassungen in einer Phase umsetzen, in der sie
primär Planungsaufwand verursachen – und keine
kostenintensiven Nachträge in der
Umsetzungsphase. [Mehr erfahren ][17]

Digitale, belastbare Bestandsdaten sind die Grundlage effizienter Projektarbeit – sowohl an
einzelnen Standorten als auch in vernetzten, standortübergreifenden Projekten. Sie ermöglichen den
wirtschaftlichen Einsatz zeitgemäßer, digitaler Kommunikations-, Planungs- und
Projektmanagementtools und tragen wesentlich zur Kostenoptimierung bei.

Neben der Bereitstellung der Bestandsdaten begleiten wir Sie – je nach Anforderung – aktiv in der
Projektumsetzung bis hin zur Projektleitung. Für eine langfristig angelegte, digitale
As-Built-Strategie bieten wir strukturierte, regelbasierte Konzepte zur kontinuierlichen
Aktualisierung Ihrer Bestandsdokumentation. Die Einführung und Anpassung der zugehörigen Prozesse
unterstützen wir ganzheitlich bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live. Wir digitalisieren und optimieren für
Sie zielgenau mit 3D Laserscanning, 3D Anlagenplanung und unserer spezifischen Beratung, bei der
Ihre Bedürfnisse zu 100% im Mittelpunkt stehen.

[Mehr erfahren][22]
 

### PARTNER DER BAUBRANCHE

DUCTIM-X unterstützt Akteure der Baubranche, die Projektrisiken und -kosten reduzieren wollen sowie
baubegleitende Qualitätssicherung und fortlaufende Terminkontrolle als unabdingbar anerkennen. Die
von uns eingesetzten, einzigartigen 3D-Scanner (statisch und mobil) mitsamt zugehöriger Software auf
Basis eines patentierten Algorithmus bieten eine digitale Bestandsaufnahme bestehender oder eine
stetige Fortschritts- und Maßhaltigkeitsüberwachung im Bau befindlicher Gebäude. Durch die
Erstellung präziser und verlässlicher 3-D-Messdaten des Baufortschritts in Kombination mit dem
Abgleich der Daten mit den beauftragten 3D-Gebäudemodellen reduzieren Sie signifikant etwaige
Änderungskosten auf der Baustelle. Nicht zuletzt übernehmen wir auch die Modellierungsdienstleistung
im ifc-Austauschformat im Rahmen des Building Information Modeling (BIM).

## How eviXscan 3D Improves Quality Control and Manufacturing?

**eviXscan 3D** excels in creating high-quality **industrial 3D scanning solutions**, including
advanced **structured light 3D scanners**, sophisticated metrology software, and comprehensive 3D
scanning services.

Our products, founded on cutting-edge structured light technology, are renowned for their
**metrology-grade precision**, speed, and innovation, designed specifically for demanding
applications in **reverse engineering**, **non-contact quality control**, and rapid prototyping.

By significantly accelerating **quality control** processes and streamlining **industrial
manufacturing** workflows, eviXscan 3D solutions directly contribute to substantial cost savings for
businesses.

Accessible globally through an extensive reseller network, our **3D scanners** support
**automotive**, **heavy industry**, **defence**, **aerospace** and many other industries across
Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, and Africa, enhancing operational efficiency and product
quality worldwide.

Our solutions are trusted by manufacturers across automotive, heavy industry, defence and aerospace
sectors. Whether you need high-precision **dimensional inspection**, **CAD comparison** or
**automated quality control**, eviXscan 3D provides reliable **optical metrology solutions** that
improve efficiency and reduce production costs.

**eviXscan 3D** excels in creating high-quality **industrial 3D scanning solutions**, including
advanced **structured light 3D scanners**, sophisticated metrology software, and comprehensive 3D
scanning services.

Our products, founded on cutting-edge structured light technology, are renowned for their
**metrology-grade precision**, speed, and innovation, designed specifically for demanding
applications in **reverse engineering**, **non-contact quality control**, and rapid prototyping.

By significantly accelerating **quality control** processes and streamlining **industrial
manufacturing** workflows, eviXscan 3D solutions directly contribute to substantial cost savings for
businesses.

**automotive**, **heavy industry**, **defence**, **aerospace** and many other industries across
Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, and Africa, enhancing operational efficiency and product
quality worldwide.

Our solutions are trusted by manufacturers across automotive, heavy industry, defence and aerospace
sectors. Whether you need high-precision **dimensional inspection**, **CAD comparison** or
**automated quality control**, eviXscan 3D provides reliable **optical metrology solutions** that
improve efficiency and reduce production costs.

[FairScan icon]

# FairScan

An Android app to scan your documents —
simple and respectful.

“The Simplest Android App for Scanning Documents.” — [ WIRED ][1]

[ Get it on Google Play ][2] [ Get it on F-Droid ][3]
[FairScan screenshot]

## Why FairScan?

### Simple

Scanning a document should never feel complicated. With FairScan, you **get a clean PDF in just a
few seconds.** The application guides you through a straightforward process so you can focus on your
document, not on the tool.
* **Easy flow:** scan, review if needed, save or share
* **Clear**, distraction-free interface
* **Automatic** document detection, crop, and enhancement
* **Instant share:** One tap to export a shareable PDF
* **OCR included:** get searchable, copy-paste ready PDFs.

### Respectful

FairScan was built on a simple principle: it should serve the interests of its users, not the
interests of a business. Its features and code were designed with that perspective in mind.
* **Privacy:** your scans stay on your device. No cloud, no account, no trackers.
* **Focus:** no ads, no nagging to upgrade, only what you need.
* **Freedom:** no watermarks, no page limits, no restrictions on sharing.
* **Transparency:** open-source code, open to review.
* **Minimal permissions:** only what is required for scanning, exporting PDFs, and optional OCR
  language downloads.

## How it works

[Step 1: Detect document]

1. Point your phone – FairScan detects the document

[Step 2: Preview]

2. Preview the scan and adjust if needed

[Step 3: Save PDF]

3. Save a PDF on your mobile device or share it instantly

### Open-source. No tricks.

FairScan is free, open-source, and built to respect you — not a business model.

[ Check it on GitHub ][4]

## Help FairScan grow

FairScan doesn't advertise, doesn't collect user data, and doesn't have a marketing budget. It grows
mainly because people recommend it to others.

### Leave a review

A positive review on Google Play helps other people discover FairScan and gives them confidence to
try it.

### Recommend FairScan

If you know someone looking for a simple document scanner, tell them about FairScan.

### Donate

If you'd like to support ongoing development financially, donations are appreciated but never
expected.

[ Donate once (Stripe) ][5] [ Donate regularly (Liberapay) ][6]

## From the blog

Discover insights, updates, and ideas behind FairScan.

### When a scan becomes a searchable PDF

June 17, 2026

When you scan a document with FairScan, you can now get a PDF which you can directly search for
text. You may also copy any text from it, for example the paragraph you were looking for, and paste
it in another application. This is the result of a text recognition system, which is often referred
to as OCR (Optical Character Recognition).

### Donations, without expectations

April 19, 2026

I've been working on FairScan for almost a year without making money from it. That was never the
goal. But even if money is not what drives the project, it raises questions about sustainability,
expectations, and the relationship between a developer and their users.

[ Read more on the blog ][7]

## Contact

Questions or feedback?

[ contact@fairscan.org ][8] [ Follow on Mastodon ][9]

## Frequently asked questions

### Is there an iOS version of the app?

No. FairScan is currently available only for Android. Any iOS application using the name "FairScan"
is developed independently and is not associated with this project.

### Can I manually adjust the pages of the generated PDF?

FairScan focuses on fast, automatic processing so you can get a PDF in a few seconds. Manual
adjustments are limited to rotating pages, reordering them, adjusting document edges, and choosing
between color and greyscale.

### Where can I download an APK?

APKs are available on [GitHub releases][10]. The SHA-256 signing certificate digest is
`820710961328e1834bcb8158092e6b6c5b519fcd3bdb2e5319ebdaf08f9ea1e8`.

### Ground Penetrating RadaR (GPR)

Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is a non-destructive geophysical technique utilized in construction
to analyze the subsurface conditions of a given site. By emitting electromagnetic pulses into the
ground and capturing the reflected signals, GPR generates a visual representation of subsurface
features. In construction applications, GPR serves multiple functions such as utility mapping,
concrete imaging, quality assurance, and environmental assessment. It facilitates the detection of
underground utilities like pipes, cables, and conduits, aiding in pre-construction planning and
excavation safety. Additionally, GPR can pinpoint the presence and positioning of reinforcement bars
(rebar) or post-tension cables within concrete slabs, ensuring structural integrity. Ground
Penetrating Radar's ability to deliver real-time subsurface insights without causing damage makes it
indispensable, enhancing safety, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness throughout construction
projects.
][85][
Learn More
[Illustration of Underground Utility Locating]

### UTILITY LOCATING Services

811 One Call centers are a not-for-profit protection service that acts as a communication link
between you and the owner/operator of any registered utilities at your excavation site. Your local
811 center will submit your excavation notification to these facility owners and operators who are
required to respond to your notification by marking their lines and communicating through means such
as positive response.
811 submits your excavation notification to registered utility facilities within your proposed
excavation area. However, not all private utility lines are registered, meaning they would not be
marked by member companies, making them the property owner’s responsibility.
To fully visualize the buried infrastructure on your property, it’s vital that you hire a
professional utility locating company like GPRS in addition to contacting 811. Our SIM-certified
Project Managers employ ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetic (EM) locators, CCTV video
cameras, acoustic water leak locators and other equipment to scan for subsurface utilities,
including depths and GPS mapping, saving time, money, and even lives by avoiding utility strikes to
protect all site employees and contractors from potential line strike damages.
GPRS provides complimentary .KMZ files for all our exterior utility locating projects. Our utility
mapping services can create an updated as-built drawing for your campus or facility. GPR services
can also be used to locate underground storage tanks (USTs), unknown utilities, and even manholes
and well heads.
][86][
Learn More
[Illustration of Subsurface Pipeline Locating]

### cctv VIDEO PIPE INSPECTION

The majority of sewer pipe defects occur underground in buried pipes that can only be accessed by
excavation or CCTV cameras via a Video Pipe Inspection (VPI). GPRS deploys both robotic crawler CCTV
pipe cameras and lateral launch cameras to document and assess water systems, drains, and conduct
sewer camera inspection services without costly excavation. Our NASSCO-certified WinCan video
pipeline inspection reports provide clients the exact location and map of each defect,
cross-referenced and tagged with a defect severity level. A CCTV sewer pipe inspection service
allows our clients to visualize every inch of water and sewer pipe within their system and to create
comprehensive repair and maintenance plans to repair pipe damage in the most cost-effective manner
possible.

(rebar) or post-tension cables within concrete slabs, ensuring structural integrity. Ground
Penetrating Radar's ability to deliver real-time subsurface insights without causing damage makes it
indispensable, enhancing safety, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness throughout construction
projects.
][85][
Learn More
[Illustration of Underground Utility Locating]

### UTILITY LOCATING Services

811 One Call centers are a not-for-profit protection service that acts as a communication link
between you and the owner/operator of any registered utilities at your excavation site. Your local
811 center will submit your excavation notification to these facility owners and operators who are
required to respond to your notification by marking their lines and communicating through means such
as positive response.
811 submits your excavation notification to registered utility facilities within your proposed
excavation area. However, not all private utility lines are registered, meaning they would not be
marked by member companies, making them the property owner’s responsibility.
To fully visualize the buried infrastructure on your property, it’s vital that you hire a
professional utility locating company like GPRS in addition to contacting 811. Our SIM-certified
Project Managers employ ground penetrating radar (GPR), electromagnetic (EM) locators, CCTV video
cameras, acoustic water leak locators and other equipment to scan for subsurface utilities,
including depths and GPS mapping, saving time, money, and even lives by avoiding utility strikes to
protect all site employees and contractors from potential line strike damages.
GPRS provides complimentary .KMZ files for all our exterior utility locating projects. Our utility
mapping services can create an updated as-built drawing for your campus or facility. GPR services
can also be used to locate underground storage tanks (USTs), unknown utilities, and even manholes
and well heads.
][86][
Learn More
[Illustration of Subsurface Pipeline Locating]

### cctv VIDEO PIPE INSPECTION

The majority of sewer pipe defects occur underground in buried pipes that can only be accessed by
excavation or CCTV cameras via a Video Pipe Inspection (VPI). GPRS deploys both robotic crawler CCTV
pipe cameras and lateral launch cameras to document and assess water systems, drains, and conduct
sewer camera inspection services without costly excavation. Our NASSCO-certified WinCan video
pipeline inspection reports provide clients the exact location and map of each defect,
cross-referenced and tagged with a defect severity level. A CCTV sewer pipe inspection service
allows our clients to visualize every inch of water and sewer pipe within their system and to create
comprehensive repair and maintenance plans to repair pipe damage in the most cost-effective manner
possible.
][87]

## Put your site on the Map///

## ///Georeferenced Utility Linework Overlay

[GEOREFERENCED UTILITY LINEWORK OVERLAY | GPRS]

GPRS provides complimentary utility maps for every utility locating project – in easy-to-use file
formats like .shp, .kmz. and .pdf. This linework is overlaid on background imagery and delivered
immediately upon completion of a project. By supplying updated existing condition drawings, we
ensure clients have actionable data for planning, designing or excavation.

## ///CAD – 2D Utility Site Plan

[CAD - 2D UTILITY SITE PLAN | GPRS]

The GPRS Mapping & Modeling Team can aggregate GPRS field markings into a CAD utility site plan that
shows the accurate vertical and horizontal position of underground utility locations. This site plan
will help you visualize your project in the planning or design phase, during construction, or even
as a permanent record of existing conditions.

# 3D Modeling

Welcome to G&P Associates, your trusted partner for advanced laser scanning and 3D modeling
solutions. We provide cutting-edge technology and expertise to help you achieve your project goals
efficiently and accurately.

Our team of technical professionals employs state-of-the-art laser scanning equipment to capture
precise and high-resolution data of any object or environment. This data is then processed through
advanced software, resulting in detailed, three-dimensional models that accurately represent the
real-world object.

Our laser scanning and 3D modeling services are highly versatile, and we can apply them across a
range of industries, including architecture, engineering, construction, and more. We pride ourselves
on our ability to deliver accurate, timely, and cost-effective lidar scanning services that meet the
unique needs of our clients.

G&P Associates is a 3D laser scanning company committed to providing exceptional customer service
and support every step of the way. Our 3D laser scanning services provide extraordinary value to our
clients throughout the planning, design, and building phases of their projects. Our in-house, highly
trained team of BIM/CAD designers and engineers work with each client to build custom deliverables
ranging from raw data to complete 3D and 2D models.

# 3D Modeling

Welcome to G&P Associates, your trusted partner for advanced laser scanning and 3D modeling
solutions. We provide cutting-edge technology and expertise to help you achieve your project goals
efficiently and accurately.

Our team of technical professionals employs state-of-the-art laser scanning equipment to capture
precise and high-resolution data of any object or environment. This data is then processed through
advanced software, resulting in detailed, three-dimensional models that accurately represent the
real-world object.

Our laser scanning and 3D modeling services are highly versatile, and we can apply them across a
range of industries, including architecture, engineering, construction, and more. We pride ourselves
on our ability to deliver accurate, timely, and cost-effective lidar scanning services that meet the
unique needs of our clients.

G&P Associates is a 3D laser scanning company committed to providing exceptional customer service
and support every step of the way. Our 3D laser scanning services provide extraordinary value to our
clients throughout the planning, design, and building phases of their projects. Our in-house, highly
trained team of BIM/CAD designers and engineers work with each client to build custom deliverables

# Scan Smarter, Work Faster

iCanscan turns your browser into a powerful scanner. Capture documents in seconds, enhance clarity,
and save directly to Google Drive or your device. No app installs, just instant results.

[Start Scanning][34][Sign Up][35]

## Get Started with Our PDF Tools

Select a tool below to start working with your PDFs — edit, scan, merge, compress, and more. Easy to
use, just one click!

[[PDF Scanner]

### PDF Scanner

### PDF Signer

Digitally sign your PDF documents securely and quickly.

][43]
[Smart Scanning]

## Fast Scanning

iCanScan automatically detects the edges of your paper, receipt, or ID card and straightens the
perspective so every scan looks professional. You can instantly resize your captures to standard
formats such as **A4, ID card, or receipt**, and the app even removes unwanted elements like fingers
in the frame—leaving only the document, clean and sharp.

[AI Cleanup & Editing]

## Smart Cleanup & Editing Tools

Beyond just scanning, iCanScan helps you prepare documents the way you need them. You can take a
**handwritten form and clean it up** to get a reusable blank template, perfect for refilling
digitally. Adding a **signature or a photo** to any document is just a tap away, with auto filter.
And with built-in markup tools like a highlighter, pen, and eraser, you can review, annotate, or
correct your scans without needing any extra software.

[Flexible Output]

## Flexible Output & Control

Whether you need a quick receipt scan or a full report, iCanScan adapts to your workflow. Choose
your output format with full control over page setup—pick **A4, A3, portrait, or landscape
layouts**, and even insert page numbers for multi-page documents. When you’re ready, you can
download your scans as **PDFs, JPGs, or PNGs**, giving you maximum flexibility to share or store
your files.

[Accessible Everywhere]

## Accessible Everywhere

iCanScan works right in your browser, which means there’s **no installation required** and you can
use it instantly on both desktop and mobile. Save your files locally or upload them directly to
**Google Drive** to keep your documents in sync across devices. And with premium, you enjoy scans
without watermarks or ads, while keeping your files private and secure.

## Pricing

* Local download only
* Ads included

* OCR + Merge & Split + Reorder

[Sign Up][45]

### Premium

$4.99/month
* Unlimited scans & downloads
* Modify Document
* Save to OneDrive
* No Ads

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to sign up to use iCanscan?

No. You can start scanning immediately as a guest without login. However, guest users have limited
features. Creating a free account unlocks extra features like Google Drive save, OCR, and more scans
per day.

### What is included in the free quota?

Guest: 5 scans/day, 5 downloads. Free sign-up: 10 scans/day, 10 downloads/day, with OCR and
merge/split features.

### What are the benefits of Premium?

Unlimited scans, no ads, no watermark, Google Drive save, advanced features, and priority support.

### Is my payment information secure?

Yes. Payments are handled by secure gateways. We do not store your card or bank details.

### Can I try Premium before purchase?

Yes. You can use guest or free accounts to test features. Referral rewards also unlock Premium for
free.

### Can I use iCanscan on mobile and desktop?

Yes. Our web app works on desktop (Chrome recommended) and mobile browsers. No installation
required.

### Are my documents private?

Yes. Files are processed securely in your browser. Cloud saves go directly to your Google Drive — we
never keep them.

### Will my scanned documents have a watermark?

Yes, for guest and free users. No watermark for Premium users.

### Can I cancel my Premium subscription anytime?

Yes. You can cancel anytime, and benefits last until your billing cycle ends.

### What if I need help?

Premium users get email support. Free users can access our Help Center and FAQ.

## 3D Scanning

3D scanning captures the shape of a physical part and turns it into usable digital data.

If CAD files are missing—or a part is worn, broken, or hard to measure-3D scanning suppliers can
create a 3D scan/mesh (and, when needed, a CAD-ready model) to support manufacturing via CNC, 3D
printing, or other processes.

[ What do I receive when requesting 3D scanning?
][33]

Typically a 3D scan file (mesh/point cloud such as STL/OBJ/PLY) and, if required, a CAD-ready model
or reference data for engineering.

[ When is 3D scanning needed?
][34]

When CAD files don’t exist, when the part is complex to measure manually, or when a worn/broken
component needs to be reproduced accurately.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][35]

The physical part (or access to it), key dimensions/tolerances if known, intended use, and whether
the output is for inspection, reverse engineering, or direct manufacturing.

[ Can a scanned file be used directly for manufacturing?
][36]

Sometimes, especially for 3D printing. For CNC machining, a scan is often used as input for reverse
engineering to create a parametric CAD model and proper drawings.

## Engineering

Engineering is the step that turns an idea, or a physical part, into production-ready files.

If only a photo, a sketch, or a broken component is available, engineering suppliers can create the
CAD model (3D design), drawings, and DFM guidance needed to manufacture the part using the right
process (CNC, 3D printing, cutting, etc.).

[ What do I receive when requesting Engineering?
][37]

Typically a CAD file (e.g., STEP), technical drawings (PDF), and guidance on materials and
manufacturing method.

[ When is Engineering needed?
][38]

When production-ready files are missing, when a design needs optimisation for manufacturing (DFM),
or when a part must be recreated from a photo/sketch/physical sample.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][39]

Photos from multiple angles, any known dimensions, intended use (loads/environment), preferred
material, and whether it’s a prototype or a batch.

[ Can a part be created from a photo or a physical item?
][40]

Yes. Photos can work for simple geometry, but best accuracy usually comes from a physical sample
plus measurements (or 3D scanning), especially for spare parts.

## 3D Printing

3D printing creates parts directly from a digital model—ideal for prototypes, spare parts, and
low-volume production.

By selecting the right process and material, 3D printing suppliers can deliver anything from durable
polymer parts to high-performance metal components—often without tooling and with short lead times.

[ What do I receive when requesting 3D printing?
][41]

Typically a finished part (or batch), material confirmation, and—when required—basic documentation
such as photos, measurements, or a certificate of conformity.

[ When do I choose 3D printing instead of CNC?
][42]

When I need fast prototypes, complex geometry, internal channels, or low-volume production without
tooling. CNC is often preferred for very tight tolerances, specific surface finishes, or certain
metals at scale.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][43]

A 3D file (STL/STEP preferred), quantity, material requirements, target tolerances, and intended use
(load, temperature, environment). If I don’t have a CAD file, engineering support can help create
one.

[ What materials can I print in?
][44]

Depending on the supplier and process, options typically include **polymers** (e.g.,
PLA/PETG/ABS/nylon), **engineering plastics** (e.g., PA, PC, carbon-fibre reinforced), and
**metals** (e.g., steel, aluminium, titanium). Availability and suitability depend on requirements
and part geometry.

## CNC & Cutting

CNC & cutting produce precise parts by machining or cutting material to shape—ideal for functional
components, brackets, fixtures, and low-to-mid volume production.

By matching requirements to the right machines and processes, CNC & cutting suppliers can deliver
parts in metals and plastics with reliable tolerances and repeatability.

[ What do I receive when requesting CNC & cutting?
][45]

Typically a finished machined/cut part (or batch), confirmation of material and tolerances, and—when
required—basic documentation such as measurements or a certificate of conformity.

[ When do I choose CNC & cutting instead of 3D printing?
][46]

When I need tighter tolerances, specific surface finishes, higher strength from solid stock, or
predictable repeatability for batches. 3D printing is often better for complex geometry and fast
iterations without machining constraints.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][47]

A CAD file (STEP preferred) and/or technical drawing (PDF), quantity, material, tolerance
requirements, surface finish needs, and deadline. If I only have a sample or photo, engineering/3D
scanning can help create production-ready files.

[ What types of CNC & cutting work can be sourced?
][48]

Yes. Photos can work for simple geometry, but best accuracy usually comes from a physical sample
plus measurements (or 3D scanning), especially for spare parts.

## Surface treatment

Surface treatment improves a part’s performance after manufacturing—adding protection, durability,
and the finish required for real-world use.

Surface treatment suppliers can support processes such as coating, anodising, blasting, polishing,
heat treatment, and corrosion protection, depending on material and requirements.

[ What do I receive when requesting surface treatment?
][49]

Typically a finished part with the specified coating/finish, and confirmation of the process and
specification used (and documentation where required).

[ When do I need surface treatment?
][50]

When I need improved corrosion resistance, wear resistance, aesthetics, friction control, or a
specific surface finish-often to meet functional, environmental, or customer requirements.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][51]

The part material, required finish/specification (if known), intended use/environment (e.g., marine,
high wear, high temperature), and any masking requirements or critical surfaces.

[ Which surface treatments are commonly available?
][52]

Depending on supplier and material, common options include **anodising, powder coating, painting,
plating, polishing, blasting, passivation, and heat treatment**. Availability and suitability depend
on requirements and geometry.

## Quality control

Quality control verifies that parts meet the required dimensions, tolerances, and documentation
before delivery.

Suppliers can support inspection and reporting - from basic measurements to CMM inspection and
traceability, depending on requirements.

[ What do I receive when requesting quality control?
][53]

Typically an inspection result (pass/fail), measurement data, and a report (e.g., dimensional
report). Certificates or traceability documentation can be included when required.

[ When do I need quality control?
][54]

When tolerances are tight, the part is safety, or mission, critical, the order value is high, or
when a customer requires documentation before accepting delivery.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][55]

A drawing or specification with tolerances, critical dimensions/features, required standards (if
any), and whether the inspection is for first article, batch sampling, or 100% inspection.

[ What types of inspection can be requested?
][56]

Depending on requirement and supplier capability: **visual inspection, dimensional checks, CMM
measurement, surface roughness checks, material verification, and documentation/traceability**.
