## 3D Scanning

3D scanning captures the shape of a physical part and turns it into usable digital data.

If CAD files are missing—or a part is worn, broken, or hard to measure-3D scanning suppliers can
create a 3D scan/mesh (and, when needed, a CAD-ready model) to support manufacturing via CNC, 3D
printing, or other processes.

[ What do I receive when requesting 3D scanning?
][33]

Typically a 3D scan file (mesh/point cloud such as STL/OBJ/PLY) and, if required, a CAD-ready model
or reference data for engineering.

[ When is 3D scanning needed?
][34]

When CAD files don’t exist, when the part is complex to measure manually, or when a worn/broken
component needs to be reproduced accurately.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][35]

The physical part (or access to it), key dimensions/tolerances if known, intended use, and whether
the output is for inspection, reverse engineering, or direct manufacturing.

[ Can a scanned file be used directly for manufacturing?
][36]

Sometimes, especially for 3D printing. For CNC machining, a scan is often used as input for reverse
engineering to create a parametric CAD model and proper drawings.

## Engineering

Engineering is the step that turns an idea, or a physical part, into production-ready files.

If only a photo, a sketch, or a broken component is available, engineering suppliers can create the
CAD model (3D design), drawings, and DFM guidance needed to manufacture the part using the right
process (CNC, 3D printing, cutting, etc.).

[ What do I receive when requesting Engineering?
][37]

Typically a CAD file (e.g., STEP), technical drawings (PDF), and guidance on materials and
manufacturing method.

[ When is Engineering needed?
][38]

When production-ready files are missing, when a design needs optimisation for manufacturing (DFM),
or when a part must be recreated from a photo/sketch/physical sample.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][39]

Photos from multiple angles, any known dimensions, intended use (loads/environment), preferred
material, and whether it’s a prototype or a batch.

[ Can a part be created from a photo or a physical item?
][40]

Yes. Photos can work for simple geometry, but best accuracy usually comes from a physical sample
plus measurements (or 3D scanning), especially for spare parts.

## 3D Printing

3D printing creates parts directly from a digital model—ideal for prototypes, spare parts, and
low-volume production.

By selecting the right process and material, 3D printing suppliers can deliver anything from durable
polymer parts to high-performance metal components—often without tooling and with short lead times.

[ What do I receive when requesting 3D printing?
][41]

Typically a finished part (or batch), material confirmation, and—when required—basic documentation
such as photos, measurements, or a certificate of conformity.

[ When do I choose 3D printing instead of CNC?
][42]

When I need fast prototypes, complex geometry, internal channels, or low-volume production without
tooling. CNC is often preferred for very tight tolerances, specific surface finishes, or certain
metals at scale.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][43]

A 3D file (STL/STEP preferred), quantity, material requirements, target tolerances, and intended use
(load, temperature, environment). If I don’t have a CAD file, engineering support can help create
one.

[ What materials can I print in?
][44]

Depending on the supplier and process, options typically include **polymers** (e.g.,
PLA/PETG/ABS/nylon), **engineering plastics** (e.g., PA, PC, carbon-fibre reinforced), and
**metals** (e.g., steel, aluminium, titanium). Availability and suitability depend on requirements
and part geometry.

## CNC & Cutting

CNC & cutting produce precise parts by machining or cutting material to shape—ideal for functional
components, brackets, fixtures, and low-to-mid volume production.

By matching requirements to the right machines and processes, CNC & cutting suppliers can deliver
parts in metals and plastics with reliable tolerances and repeatability.

[ What do I receive when requesting CNC & cutting?
][45]

Typically a finished machined/cut part (or batch), confirmation of material and tolerances, and—when
required—basic documentation such as measurements or a certificate of conformity.

[ When do I choose CNC & cutting instead of 3D printing?
][46]

When I need tighter tolerances, specific surface finishes, higher strength from solid stock, or
predictable repeatability for batches. 3D printing is often better for complex geometry and fast
iterations without machining constraints.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][47]

A CAD file (STEP preferred) and/or technical drawing (PDF), quantity, material, tolerance
requirements, surface finish needs, and deadline. If I only have a sample or photo, engineering/3D
scanning can help create production-ready files.

[ What types of CNC & cutting work can be sourced?
][48]

Yes. Photos can work for simple geometry, but best accuracy usually comes from a physical sample
plus measurements (or 3D scanning), especially for spare parts.

## Surface treatment

Surface treatment improves a part’s performance after manufacturing—adding protection, durability,
and the finish required for real-world use.

Surface treatment suppliers can support processes such as coating, anodising, blasting, polishing,
heat treatment, and corrosion protection, depending on material and requirements.

[ What do I receive when requesting surface treatment?
][49]

Typically a finished part with the specified coating/finish, and confirmation of the process and
specification used (and documentation where required).

[ When do I need surface treatment?
][50]

When I need improved corrosion resistance, wear resistance, aesthetics, friction control, or a
specific surface finish-often to meet functional, environmental, or customer requirements.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][51]

The part material, required finish/specification (if known), intended use/environment (e.g., marine,
high wear, high temperature), and any masking requirements or critical surfaces.

[ Which surface treatments are commonly available?
][52]

Depending on supplier and material, common options include **anodising, powder coating, painting,
plating, polishing, blasting, passivation, and heat treatment**. Availability and suitability depend
on requirements and geometry.

## Quality control

Quality control verifies that parts meet the required dimensions, tolerances, and documentation
before delivery.

Suppliers can support inspection and reporting - from basic measurements to CMM inspection and
traceability, depending on requirements.

[ What do I receive when requesting quality control?
][53]

Typically an inspection result (pass/fail), measurement data, and a report (e.g., dimensional
report). Certificates or traceability documentation can be included when required.

[ When do I need quality control?
][54]

When tolerances are tight, the part is safety, or mission, critical, the order value is high, or
when a customer requires documentation before accepting delivery.

[ What should I provide to get started?
][55]

A drawing or specification with tolerances, critical dimensions/features, required standards (if
any), and whether the inspection is for first article, batch sampling, or 100% inspection.

[ What types of inspection can be requested?
][56]

Depending on requirement and supplier capability: **visual inspection, dimensional checks, CMM
measurement, surface roughness checks, material verification, and documentation/traceability**.

# Who We Are

Lumispot was founded in 2017, headquartered in Wuxi, boasting a registered capital of CNY 78.55
million. The company covers an area of approximately 14,000 square meters and is powered by a
dedicated team of over 300 employees. Over the past 9+ years, Lumispot has emerged as a frontrunner
in the specialized field of laser information technology, underpinned by a robust technical
foundation.

Lumispot specializes in the research and development of laser technology, providing a diverse
portfolio of products. This range encompasses laser rangfinder modules, laser designators,
high-power semiconductor laser, diode pumping modules, LiDAR lasers, as well as comprehensive
systems including structured lasers, ceilometers, laser dazzlers. Our products find extensive
applications across various sectors such as defense and security, LiDAR systems, remote sensing,
beam rider guidance, industrial pumping and technical research.

# Online-Shop für Messpunkte & messtechnisches Zubehör für 3D Scanner

Verbrauchsmaterial und Zubehör für optische Messtechnik sind meist sehr teuer – nicht bei uns! Wir
haben ein branchenübergreifendes Expertennetzwerk zusammengebracht und gemeinsam die
Herstellungsprozesse des Messtechnikzubehörs ganz genau unter die Lupe genommen und Schritt für
Schritt optimiert. So können wir Ihnen Produkte anbieten, die qualitativ denen der OEMs entsprechen,
aber deutlich günstiger sind. Ganz nach dem Motto: hohe Qualität zum niedrigen Preis “Made in
Germany“.
[ zum Shop ][11]

## Produktübersicht

Messpunkte
Ganz gleich, welche Bezeichnung Sie bevorzugen - Referenzpunkte, Referenzmarken, Scanning Targets,
Scanning Dots oder ganz klassisch Messpunkte - bei uns sind Sie genau richtig! Unser Weg als
Online-Shop für 3D Scanner Zubehör begann mit der Entwicklung von Messpunkten. In enger
Zusammenarbeit mit Experten für Druck und Messtechnik haben wir eine kostengünstige Alternative zu
den teuren OEM-Produkten (etwa von Creaform, GOM, Zeiss, Hexagon und Shining3D) entwickelt. Mit
einer Reihe von Maßnahmen konnten wir die Beschaffungs- und Produktionskosten erheblich senken.
Diesen Kostenvorteil geben wir gerne an Sie weiter.
[ Messpunkte ][12]
Scanningspray
Ein weiteres unverzichtbares Produkt aus dem Bereich 3D-Digitalisierung ist ebenfalls in unserem
Messtechnik Online-Shop zu finden: das Scanningspray. Diese speziell entwickelten Mattierungssprays
ermöglichen das problemlose Scannen von spiegelnden und durchsichtigen Oberflächen. Das von unserem
Partner Graichen entwickelte ATTBLIME Spray ist ein technisches Spezialprodukt, das sich nach dem
Scanvorgang selbstständig verflüchtigt, sodass keinerlei Nachbearbeitung erforderlich ist. Die
herausragenden Eigenschaften dieses Sprays, insbesondere in Bezug auf Gesundheits- und
Umweltverträglichkeit, sowie die breite Palette an verfügbaren Produkten machen es einzigartig im
Wettbewerbsumfeld.
[ Scanningspray ][13]
Messtechnisches Zubehör
Wir vertreiben nicht nur messtechnisches Zubehör, sondern arbeiten selbst tagtäglich mit optischer
3D Messtechnik. Somit testen wir unsere eigenen Produkte kontinuierlich in der Praxis und können
daraus Optimierungspotential und neue Produktideen ableiten. Das bedeutet: Unsere praktischen
Erfahrungen ermöglichen es uns, die spezifischen Anforderungen an erforderliches Zubehör zu kennen
und für Sie aktiv die Entwicklung neuer Produkte voranzutreiben.
[ Messtechnisches Zubehör ][14]
Workstations
Vervollständigen Sie Ihre Tool-Kette mit einer maßgeschneiderten Workstation: Die von uns
angebotenen Workstations sind für die Nutzung mit optischen Messsystemen optimiert. Auf Wunsch
können wir diese für Sie vorbereiten, indem wir die Messsoftware vorinstallieren. Die erforderlichen
Lizenzen können ebenfalls über uns bezogen werden.
[ Workstations ][15]

Wir arbeiten ständig daran für die Welt der 3D Scanner und der 3D Digitalisierung innovative
Zubehörprodukte zu entwickeln. Wir sind stolz darauf Ihnen unsere Produktneuheiten präsentieren zu
dürfen:

## Produktübersicht

einer Reihe von Maßnahmen konnten wir die Beschaffungs- und Produktionskosten erheblich senken.
Diesen Kostenvorteil geben wir gerne an Sie weiter.

Scanningspray
Ein weiteres unverzichtbares Produkt aus dem Bereich 3D-Digitalisierung ist ebenfalls in unserem

ermöglichen das problemlose Scannen von spiegelnden und durchsichtigen Oberflächen. Das von unserem
Partner Graichen entwickelte ATTBLIME Spray ist ein technisches Spezialprodukt, das sich nach dem
Scanvorgang selbstständig verflüchtigt, sodass keinerlei Nachbearbeitung erforderlich ist. Die
herausragenden Eigenschaften dieses Sprays, insbesondere in Bezug auf Gesundheits- und
Umweltverträglichkeit, sowie die breite Palette an verfügbaren Produkten machen es einzigartig im
Wettbewerbsumfeld.

daraus Optimierungspotential und neue Produktideen ableiten. Das bedeutet: Unsere praktischen
Erfahrungen ermöglichen es uns, die spezifischen Anforderungen an erforderliches Zubehör zu kennen
und für Sie aktiv die Entwicklung neuer Produkte voranzutreiben.
[ Messtechnisches Zubehör ][14]

Vervollständigen Sie Ihre Tool-Kette mit einer maßgeschneiderten Workstation: Die von uns
angebotenen Workstations sind für die Nutzung mit optischen Messsystemen optimiert. Auf Wunsch
können wir diese für Sie vorbereiten, indem wir die Messsoftware vorinstallieren. Die erforderlichen
Lizenzen können ebenfalls über uns bezogen werden.

We go to great lengths to ensure that you enjoy the [best home fitness training][65] experience
possible. Our entire process centers around you as we create a customizable home training program,
nutrition program, and overall experience tailored to your goals, expectations, and preferences.

## Industry-Leading Technology


Aside from our team of talented and motivated trainers, we also provide the best in-home training
experience by leveraging cutting-edge technology during your workout routine. Access to our app is
complimentary for all personal training clients. You can take advantage of convenient workout and
progress tracking, virtual workouts, and nutritional logging for both iPhone and Android.

Plus, we don’t know anyone else using 3D body scanners the way we do. Each month, clients receive a
free [3D body scan][66] to measure lean muscle gain, fat loss, and other changes in body shape that
the scale can’t tell you. Our personal trainer will then use this information to understand how
you’re responding to our one-on-one training program, and recalibrate your plan as needed to prevent
plateaus and ensure optimal results.

## Proven Results


Speaking of results, our team is more results-driven than any other trainers you’ll find. Unlike at
most gyms, our personal trainers aren’t required to do any sales — but they are required to help you
get measurable results. We have a passion for fitness and body transformations, and we’re just as
committed to seeing your goals take shape as you are. Through our 3D scans, we’ll ensure our
trainers are making real progress, so your efforts during the training sessions never go wasted.
Your personal trainer in Scottsdale will make sure to empower and support you with knowledge,
skills, accountability and motivation boosting your self-esteem, creating a healthy lifestyle, and
delivering life-changing results.

Of course, [Weight Loss][67], fitness transformations, and body shape aren’t the only important
aspects of exercise. Our trainers are also experts in the functional aspects of physical activity,
including [corrective exercise][68] and senior fitness training. Whether you’re suffering from
health issues such as chronic pain, or you want to focus on elevating your fitness, you can rest
assured that our personal trainer will help you meet your goals without risking further injury. Our
Scottsdale personal trainers, along with every personal trainer we hire in each new city we launch,
specializes in both alleviating aches and pains and helping you achieve drastic fitness
transformations. Whether you're passionate about cardio and strength training, or you just train for
fun, a great personal trainer will accompany you on your fitness journey and will help you develop
the right training philosophy to achieve success.

## Fast Growing


Mobile Trainers is now the fastest growing home personal training company in the US. Now operating
in four cities, our goal is to provide access to an elite in-home personal trainer experience to as
many people as possible. Look for us in [Phoenix][69], [Dallas][70], [Austin][71], [Miami][72],
[Denver][73], and [Seattle][74].

# NAPS2 - Not Another PDF Scanner

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

NAPS2 is free and open source scanning software for [Windows][6], [Mac][7] and [Linux][8].

Easily scan with devices from Canon, Brother, HP, Epson, Fujitsu, and more. Then save to PDF, TIFF,
JPEG, or PNG with a single click.

[ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][9] [ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][10] [ More
Files ][11] [ [Download from the Microsoft Store] ][12]

## Use the best drivers for your scanner

Choose between WIA and TWAIN drivers, whichever works better for your scanner. Also choose settings
like DPI, page size, and bit depth. Scan from a flatbed or automatic document feeder (ADF),
including duplex support.

## Rotate, crop, and rearrange images

Drag and drop your pages into whatever order you like. Interleave pages for manual duplex scanning.
Rotate your pages by hand or automatically deskew to the right angle. Use image editing tools to
crop or change brightness and contrast.

## Identify text using OCR

Search through text included in your PDFs by using optical character recognition (OCR), in any of
over 100 languages.

## Use NAPS2 in your native language

Choose from over 40 different languages. If your language isn't available yet, [help translate!][13]

## Share scanners across the network

Use scanners connected to other computers on your local network. Turn any scanner into a wireless
scanner usable from your laptop or phone. [Read more.][14]

## Tools for power users and businesses

* Optional [command-line interface (CLI)][15] for automation and scripting
* [NAPS2.Sdk][16] scanning library for .NET developers
* [MSI installer][17] and [application-level configuration][18] available for group policy (GPO)
  deployment
* [Portable archives][19] available (doesn't require installation)

## Free and open source

NAPS2 is completely free to use for both individuals and businesses, and includes no ads or unwanted
software. If NAPS2 has helped you, consider making a donation.

* Low-volume parts

injection molding or machining.

## Frequently Ask Questions

#### What is 3D printing?

3D printing is a process of creating three-dimensional objects from a digital file using a 3D
printer. The printer uses additive manufacturing techniques to build the object layer by layer.

#### What types of 3D printing services are available?

There are various types of 3D printing services available, including Fused Deposition Modeling
(FDM), Stereolithography (SLA)

#### What materials can be used for 3D printing?

A range of materials can be used for 3D printing, including plastics, metals, ceramics, and
composites.

#### What types of projects are suitable for 3D printing services?

3D printing services are suitable for a wide range of projects, including prototypes, custom parts,
and complex designs.

#### Can I use 3D printing as a service for prototyping?

Yes, 3D printing as a service is widely used for prototyping purposes. It allows you to quickly and
cost-effectively create physical prototypes of your designs for testing and validation.

#### How do 3D printing services ensure the quality of printed objects?

Quality in 3D printing services is ensured through:
* **Advanced Materials:** Using high-quality printing materials suitable for the specific
  application.
* **Precision Printers:** Utilizing cutting-edge 3D printers capable of fine details and accuracy.
* **Layer Consistency:** Ensuring consistent layer adhesion for structural integrity.
* **Testing & Validation:** Conducting thorough testing and validation of prototypes.

#### What is the scope of 3D printing services, and how can they benefit businesses?

3D printing services encompass the creation of three-dimensional objects from digital designs using
additive manufacturing techniques. These services offer numerous benefits to businesses:
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Ideas can be transformed into physical prototypes quickly, aiding in design
  refinement.
* **Customization:** Tailor products to individual needs, enhancing customer satisfaction.
* **Cost-Efficiency:** Reduced material wastage and efficient production lower costs.
* **Complex Designs:** 3D printing allows intricate designs that traditional methods struggle with.
* **Speed-to-Market:** Accelerate product development and launch timelines.

#### Are there cost savings associated with 3D printing consulting?

Yes, consultants identify ways to reduce costs by minimizing material waste, streamlining
production, and optimizing 3D printing processes.

#### How do I choose the right 3D printing consulting partner?

Choose a partner with industry experience, a successful project portfolio, and a collaborative
approach to understand and meet your needs.

#### What is the process of engaging with a 3D printing consulting service?

The process involves an initial consultation to discuss your goals, followed by analysis, proposal,
and guided implementation by the consultant.

## Frequently Ask Questions

#### What is 3D printing?

3D printing is a process of creating three-dimensional objects from a digital file using a 3D
printer. The printer uses additive manufacturing techniques to build the object layer by layer.

#### What types of 3D printing services are available?

There are various types of 3D printing services available, including Fused Deposition Modeling
(FDM), Stereolithography (SLA)

#### What materials can be used for 3D printing?

A range of materials can be used for 3D printing, including plastics, metals, ceramics, and
composites.

#### What types of projects are suitable for 3D printing services?

3D printing services are suitable for a wide range of projects, including prototypes, custom parts,
and complex designs.

#### Can I use 3D printing as a service for prototyping?

Yes, 3D printing as a service is widely used for prototyping purposes. It allows you to quickly and
cost-effectively create physical prototypes of your designs for testing and validation.

#### How do 3D printing services ensure the quality of printed objects?

Quality in 3D printing services is ensured through:
* **Advanced Materials:** Using high-quality printing materials suitable for the specific
  application.
* **Precision Printers:** Utilizing cutting-edge 3D printers capable of fine details and accuracy.
* **Layer Consistency:** Ensuring consistent layer adhesion for structural integrity.
* **Testing & Validation:** Conducting thorough testing and validation of prototypes.

#### What is the scope of 3D printing services, and how can they benefit businesses?

3D printing services encompass the creation of three-dimensional objects from digital designs using
additive manufacturing techniques. These services offer numerous benefits to businesses:
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Ideas can be transformed into physical prototypes quickly, aiding in design
  refinement.
* **Customization:** Tailor products to individual needs, enhancing customer satisfaction.
* **Cost-Efficiency:** Reduced material wastage and efficient production lower costs.
* **Complex Designs:** 3D printing allows intricate designs that traditional methods struggle with.
* **Speed-to-Market:** Accelerate product development and launch timelines.

#### Are there cost savings associated with 3D printing consulting?

Yes, consultants identify ways to reduce costs by minimizing material waste, streamlining
production, and optimizing 3D printing processes.

#### How do I choose the right 3D printing consulting partner?

Choose a partner with industry experience, a successful project portfolio, and a collaborative
approach to understand and meet your needs.

#### What is the process of engaging with a 3D printing consulting service?

The process involves an initial consultation to discuss your goals, followed by analysis, proposal,
and guided implementation by the consultant.

[[Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing] ][66]
[view][67]
3D Scanning Provides Key Weapon for Aerospace and Defense Manufacturing The current revolution in
manufacturing, driven by digital technologies, is transforming the global production landscape.
While artificial intelligence, augmented reality, and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) are
increasing production efficiency and time to market, 3D scanning still has not been exploited by
aerospace and defense manufacturers for its full potential to do the same.
[One-Stop Shop: NVision's Comprehensive Reverse Engineering and Expanded Metallurgy Services Draws
Rave Reviews][68]
[[metallurgical testing] ][69]
[view][70]

When a leading aerospace company faced the challenge of replicating critical components without
original design documentation, it turned to NVision, Inc. (Southlake, TX). NVision provides complete
reverse engineering, encompassing 3D scanning, CAD modeling, 2D drawings, and materials analysis.

[3D Scanning, Essential Tool for U.S. Military Manufacturers][71]
[[Quality Magazine] ][72]
[view][73]
3D scanning technology is transforming the military manufacturing industry by offering significant
benefits in speed, precision, efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and quality. By capturing 3D data of
physical parts with precision beyond that of other tools, scanning helps defense contractors
optimize designs, detect deviations early, accelerate compliance, and rapidly produce replacement
parts.
[NVision Hits the Right Note: Featured in Manufacturing Engineering & Technology and the Advanced
Carbons Council][74]
[[MET] ][75]
[view][76]
NVision 3D was recently featured in both Manufacturing Engineering & Technology and the Advanced
Carbons Council for our role in helping Butler Trombones create ultra-light, carbon-fiber
instruments for the U.S. Marine Band and horn players worldwide.
[Reverse Engineer Obsolete Parts with 3D Scanning][77]
[[Manufacturing Engineering Magazine] ][78]
[view][79]
A semiconductor manufacturer faced a production shutdown when some of its suppliers could no longer
provide replacement parts for its aging production equipment. After reverse engineering the parts
with 3D scanning, the manufacturer now regularly reproduces and reinstalls the discontinued parts as
they age.
[3-D Measurement: An Essential Time-Saving Tool for Industry][80]
[[Quality Magazine ] ][81]
[view][82]

The science and technology of 3-D measurement has evolved dramatically in recent decades.
Accordingly, a wide range of industries continue to adopt 3-D scanning as a key tool for ensuring
optimal quality of manufactured goods, reverse engineering and other related processes.

[ A Bird Damaged Boeing 737 Returns to Service in 48 Hours][83]
[[Cutting Tool Magazine] ][84]
[view][85]
Swift work by NVision, Inc., a leader in 3D non-contact optical scanning/measurement for more than
29 years, helped a major U.S. airline quickly repair a bird-damaged Boeing 737 wing and return the
restored jet back to flight in just two days. The rapid turnaround helped the airline avoid the
financial losses typically incurred by grounding aircraft.
[3D Scanning Accelerates RedBone Production of World-Champion Goose Calls][86]
[[goose call] ][87]
[view][88]
After scanning two key components of a call--the barrel and the insert--NVision (Southlake, Texas)
provides RedBone with computer-aided design (CAD) files containing all the dimensional details of
the hand-built parts, which are then used for reproduction.
[Laser Scanning Accelerates Power Plant Conversions to Natural Gas][89]
[[coal to gas conversions] ][90]
[view][91]

NVision Inc.’s engineering services help coal-fired power plants that are converting to natural gas
quickly determine optimal locations for installing updated instrumentation.

[NVision Helps Hamar Build Perfect-Fit Roof Racks Faster][92]
[[toyota truck] ][93]
[view][94]
At Hamar Industries, designing custom roof racks for a wide range of cars and off-road
vehicles—including the Toyota Tacoma, Tundra, and 4Runner—just got faster and more efficient, thanks
to NVision Inc.'s advanced 3D laser scanning and modeling services.
[NVision's 3D Scanning Expertise Accelerates Breast Implant and ENT Device Design][95]
[[breast implant and ENT device] ][96]
[view][97]
In the world of medical device manufacturing, design delays don’t just slow down business—they can
postpone critical improvements in patient care. The consequences aren’t merely financial; even minor
setbacks carry a very real human toll.
[Aiming for Excellence: How NVision’s 3D Laser Scanning Helped Soft Air USA® Cut Three Months from
Replica Development][98]
[[Creating a replica] ][99]
[view][100]

Bringing a highly accurate Airsoft replica to market often involves long development cycles and
complex tooling workflows. For Soft Air USA®, traditional mold-based methods were stretching
timelines and adding unnecessary cost and risk.

[NVision Helps Orthodontic Supplier Recalibrate Cone-Beam CT Scanner][101]
[[Cone-Beam CT Scanner] ][102]
[view][103]
Learn how NVision helped an orthodontic supplier recalibrate its CBCT scanner by providing
independent, high-accuracy optical measurements.
[From “Shark Tank” to Scalable Design Innovation: How NVision Helped ReadeREST Expand Faster][104]
[[Readerest clips] ][105]
[view][106]
NVision’s 3D scanning and reverse engineering turn physical products into flexible digital models,
making it faster and more cost-effective to create, test, and launch new design variations.
[Defeating a Design Bottleneck: When Critical Geometry Exists Only in Physical Form][107]
[[priority designs] ][108]
[view][109]
When critical geometry exists only in physical form, the design process can stall. NVision helped
Priority Designs digitize a complex headform—reducing reverse engineering costs by 70% while
accelerating development and ensuring accurate fit and performance for protective eyewear.
[How 3D Scanning Preserves Museum Collections][110]
[[art and culture] ][111]
[view][112]
What happens when an irreplaceable work of art is lost to fire, disaster, or deterioration? Museums
are increasingly turning to 3D scanning to preserve collections, support restoration, expand
accessibility, and create new opportunities for research and public engagement.
[How 3D Scanning Saves Time Across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product Development][113]
[[turbine rotor assembly] ][114]
[view][115]

Few statements have been as enduring as the aphorism "Time is Money." It rings as true in 2026 as
when it first appeared in print in 1719.

optimize designs, detect deviations early, accelerate compliance, and rapidly produce replacement
parts.
[NVision Hits the Right Note: Featured in Manufacturing Engineering & Technology and the Advanced
Carbons Council][74]
[[MET] ][75]
[view][76]
NVision 3D was recently featured in both Manufacturing Engineering & Technology and the Advanced
Carbons Council for our role in helping Butler Trombones create ultra-light, carbon-fiber
instruments for the U.S. Marine Band and horn players worldwide.
[Reverse Engineer Obsolete Parts with 3D Scanning][77]
[[Manufacturing Engineering Magazine] ][78]
[view][79]
A semiconductor manufacturer faced a production shutdown when some of its suppliers could no longer
provide replacement parts for its aging production equipment. After reverse engineering the parts
with 3D scanning, the manufacturer now regularly reproduces and reinstalls the discontinued parts as
they age.
[3-D Measurement: An Essential Time-Saving Tool for Industry][80]
[[Quality Magazine ] ][81]
[view][82]

The science and technology of 3-D measurement has evolved dramatically in recent decades.
Accordingly, a wide range of industries continue to adopt 3-D scanning as a key tool for ensuring
optimal quality of manufactured goods, reverse engineering and other related processes.

[ A Bird Damaged Boeing 737 Returns to Service in 48 Hours][83]
[[Cutting Tool Magazine] ][84]
[view][85]
Swift work by NVision, Inc., a leader in 3D non-contact optical scanning/measurement for more than
29 years, helped a major U.S. airline quickly repair a bird-damaged Boeing 737 wing and return the
restored jet back to flight in just two days. The rapid turnaround helped the airline avoid the
financial losses typically incurred by grounding aircraft.
[3D Scanning Accelerates RedBone Production of World-Champion Goose Calls][86]
[[goose call] ][87]
[view][88]
After scanning two key components of a call--the barrel and the insert--NVision (Southlake, Texas)
provides RedBone with computer-aided design (CAD) files containing all the dimensional details of
the hand-built parts, which are then used for reproduction.
[Laser Scanning Accelerates Power Plant Conversions to Natural Gas][89]
[[coal to gas conversions] ][90]
[view][91]

NVision Inc.’s engineering services help coal-fired power plants that are converting to natural gas
quickly determine optimal locations for installing updated instrumentation.

[NVision Helps Hamar Build Perfect-Fit Roof Racks Faster][92]
[[toyota truck] ][93]
[view][94]
At Hamar Industries, designing custom roof racks for a wide range of cars and off-road
vehicles—including the Toyota Tacoma, Tundra, and 4Runner—just got faster and more efficient, thanks
to NVision Inc.'s advanced 3D laser scanning and modeling services.
[NVision's 3D Scanning Expertise Accelerates Breast Implant and ENT Device Design][95]
[[breast implant and ENT device] ][96]
[view][97]
In the world of medical device manufacturing, design delays don’t just slow down business—they can
postpone critical improvements in patient care. The consequences aren’t merely financial; even minor
setbacks carry a very real human toll.
[Aiming for Excellence: How NVision’s 3D Laser Scanning Helped Soft Air USA® Cut Three Months from
Replica Development][98]
[[Creating a replica] ][99]
[view][100]

Bringing a highly accurate Airsoft replica to market often involves long development cycles and
complex tooling workflows. For Soft Air USA®, traditional mold-based methods were stretching
timelines and adding unnecessary cost and risk.

[NVision Helps Orthodontic Supplier Recalibrate Cone-Beam CT Scanner][101]
[[Cone-Beam CT Scanner] ][102]
[view][103]
Learn how NVision helped an orthodontic supplier recalibrate its CBCT scanner by providing
independent, high-accuracy optical measurements.
[From “Shark Tank” to Scalable Design Innovation: How NVision Helped ReadeREST Expand Faster][104]
[[Readerest clips] ][105]
[view][106]
NVision’s 3D scanning and reverse engineering turn physical products into flexible digital models,
making it faster and more cost-effective to create, test, and launch new design variations.
[Defeating a Design Bottleneck: When Critical Geometry Exists Only in Physical Form][107]
[[priority designs] ][108]
[view][109]
When critical geometry exists only in physical form, the design process can stall. NVision helped
Priority Designs digitize a complex headform—reducing reverse engineering costs by 70% while
accelerating development and ensuring accurate fit and performance for protective eyewear.
[How 3D Scanning Preserves Museum Collections][110]
[[art and culture] ][111]
[view][112]
What happens when an irreplaceable work of art is lost to fire, disaster, or deterioration? Museums
are increasingly turning to 3D scanning to preserve collections, support restoration, expand
accessibility, and create new opportunities for research and public engagement.
[How 3D Scanning Saves Time Across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product Development][113]
[[turbine rotor assembly] ][114]
[view][115]

Few statements have been as enduring as the aphorism "Time is Money." It rings as true in 2026 as
when it first appeared in print in 1719.

### FAQs for 3D Printing Services

### [What is the cost for 3D printing services?][41]

3D printing cost in Chennai depends on the technology used (FDM, SLA, SLS, or MJF), material, part
size, finish, and delivery timeline. Simple prototypes cost less, while high-detail or metal parts
cost more. Final pricing is shared after reviewing the 3D file and requirements.

### [What products can be made using 3D printing?][42]

3D printing is used to manufacture prototypes, enclosures, fixtures, gears, miniature models,
sculptures, medical models, custom trophies, and functional industrial parts. It allows rapid
production of complex designs that are difficult or expensive to make using traditional
manufacturing.

### [What materials are used in professional 3D printing?][43]

Professional 3D printing uses plastics like PLA, ABS, Nylon, PETG, and carbon-fiber reinforced
materials. It also supports metal 3D printing using aluminium, stainless steel, and titanium, along
with composite and ceramic-based materials for specialized applications.

### [Which type of industries use 3D printing services?][44]
1. Automotive 3D printing
2. Medical devices 3D printing
3. Aerospace 3D printing
4. Mechanical 3D printing

### FAQs for 3D Printing Services

### [What is the cost for 3D printing services?][41]

3D printing cost in Chennai depends on the technology used (FDM, SLA, SLS, or MJF), material, part
size, finish, and delivery timeline. Simple prototypes cost less, while high-detail or metal parts
cost more. Final pricing is shared after reviewing the 3D file and requirements.

### [What products can be made using 3D printing?][42]

3D printing is used to manufacture prototypes, enclosures, fixtures, gears, miniature models,
sculptures, medical models, custom trophies, and functional industrial parts. It allows rapid
production of complex designs that are difficult or expensive to make using traditional
manufacturing.

### [What materials are used in professional 3D printing?][43]

Professional 3D printing uses plastics like PLA, ABS, Nylon, PETG, and carbon-fiber reinforced
materials. It also supports metal 3D printing using aluminium, stainless steel, and titanium, along
with composite and ceramic-based materials for specialized applications.

5.00k
I had a great experience meeting with Adam. He was very kind, honest, and genuinely helpful. He took
the time to listen to my idea, explained everything clearly, and gave me thoughtful and realistic
advice. I really appreciated his professionalism and transparency. I would definitely recommend him
to anyone looking for guidance in product design and development.✨️
[ Product Design and Development ][36]

###### Ana Petrovic

5.00k
This place is absolutely amazing! I have a small puppy whose skull hadn’t fully fused—his brain was
only covered by skin. His siblings constantly tried to chew on his head, and he would scream out in
pain. I reached out to Denver 3D to create a custom helmet for him, and they delivered exactly what
I needed! The helmet fit perfectly—after adding some simple straps, he was able to safely play with
his siblings without any risk to his head. They had the helmet ready in just 3–4 hours, and I even
got a set in slightly increasing sizes to accommodate his growth. The pricing was extremely
reasonable, and the peace of mind it brought is priceless. I absolutely recommend Denver 3D 100%!
They went above and beyond to help keep my little guy safe.
[ Custom Fabrication ][37]

###### Nicole Thibault

5.00k
I was upgrading my Element Enduro Ecto RC Crawler to include headlights. I needed a grill 3D printed
out of ABS in order to accomodate for the high heat of the led lights. I contacted Kian at Denver 3D
print Co. Kian was very helpful. I sent over a file I obtained from MyTrickRC, where i bought the
lights. Kian responded immediately with options and prices. The price was very reasonable. They sent
over the invoice right away, and my parts were reading the next morning. They were exactly what I
needed. I did a little sanding to remove the shine and some rough spots, but that's it. Maybe 30
seconds of sanding. Overall I am extremely happy with the product, service, timeliness, and
professionalism of this company.
[ Custom Fabrication ][38]

###### Charles Beasley

5.00k
I worked with Adam at Denver 3D Print Company to develop a product I invented. It was my first time
inventing something and Adam was great at walking me through the process. We went through multiple
rounds of design and material testing; making prototypes on the 3D printers at his shop. As a former
patent examiner, he was able to help me put together the documents needed to file for my patent. I
really liked being able to keep this local and work with someone mask to mask. I plan to work with
Adam again and recommend you do so as well.
[ Product Design, Development and Patent ][39]

###### Chad Hadersbeck

5.00k
Adam and his group were wonderful. We came in with a very general idea, and he not only took the
idea to the next level, but also helped manifest its production . His creativity and engineering
skills, and computer design was next level. Would highly highly recommend.
[ Product Design, Development and Production ][40]

###### Sam Sherman

5.00k
I am a small business owner that has been working with Denver 3D Print Company on developing parts
for my patent that I have received. This company is hands down the best I have been working with on
developing parts, their knowledge of the process of CAD design, 3D printing and applying and getting
a patent is awesome. I would highly recommend giving them the opportunity to show you why they are
the team you want on your side.
[ Product Design, Development and Patent ][41]

###### Kevin Edgmon

5.00k
Adam is knowledgeable and personable, and took had an open-minded, collaborative approach to my
unique sculpture project. He helped me both with the scan I needed and some new resources, and
suggested refinements to my basic process ideas without trying to sell me things I didn’t need. Much
appreciated!
[ Custom Fabrication and 3D Scanning ][42]

###### JT

5.00k
I had a great experience working with Adam and the team at Denver 3D Print Company. They helped me
3D scan a carbon fiber tow hook cover for my car, which I needed in order to print a PET-CF
replica—avoiding the need to drill into the original part. Once printed, the piece was wrapped in
carbon fiber PPF to attempt to match the bumper. Adam delivered the scan with an impressively quick
turnaround and went above and beyond to make sure the final file met (and exceeded) expectations. I
highly recommend Denver 3D Print Company for any custom projects you might have.
[ Custom Fabrication and 3D Scanning ][43]

###### Charles Young

5.00k
What a great experience with Denver 3D Print Company. They are always good at communicating and
staying on top of the deadline. They have wonderful suggestions, and the pricing was the best in
town. I work for a large company, and they were able to do a large order for me which included
hundreds of 3D prints. I would totally recommend them to anyone looking to have 3D prints.
[ Custom Fabrication and 3D Printing ][44]

###### Tim Wilt

## **FAQ's**

## What kinds of customers do you work with?

Inventors. Startups. Established businesses. Architects. Attorneys. We work with a wide variety of
people who need help solving a problem.

## How much do your services usually cost?

There’s a wide range of costs but here are a few guidelines. For a simple product consisting of
fewer than 5 custom parts and no electronics, the cost is generally below $10,000. The more
complexity, the greater the investment. It can range from 10s of thousands to more than $100k (on
rare occasions). An initial consultation and quote is always free at Protobear.

## What locations do you serve?

While based in Denver, we serve clients across the US and the world.

5.00k
This place is absolutely amazing! I have a small puppy whose skull hadn’t fully fused—his brain was
only covered by skin. His siblings constantly tried to chew on his head, and he would scream out in
pain. I reached out to Denver 3D to create a custom helmet for him, and they delivered exactly what
I needed! The helmet fit perfectly—after adding some simple straps, he was able to safely play with
his siblings without any risk to his head. They had the helmet ready in just 3–4 hours, and I even
got a set in slightly increasing sizes to accommodate his growth. The pricing was extremely
reasonable, and the peace of mind it brought is priceless. I absolutely recommend Denver 3D 100%!
They went above and beyond to help keep my little guy safe.

5.00k
I was upgrading my Element Enduro Ecto RC Crawler to include headlights. I needed a grill 3D printed
out of ABS in order to accomodate for the high heat of the led lights. I contacted Kian at Denver 3D
print Co. Kian was very helpful. I sent over a file I obtained from MyTrickRC, where i bought the
lights. Kian responded immediately with options and prices. The price was very reasonable. They sent
over the invoice right away, and my parts were reading the next morning. They were exactly what I
needed. I did a little sanding to remove the shine and some rough spots, but that's it. Maybe 30
seconds of sanding. Overall I am extremely happy with the product, service, timeliness, and
professionalism of this company.

rounds of design and material testing; making prototypes on the 3D printers at his shop. As a former
patent examiner, he was able to help me put together the documents needed to file for my patent. I
really liked being able to keep this local and work with someone mask to mask. I plan to work with
Adam again and recommend you do so as well.

## **FAQ's**

## What kinds of customers do you work with?

Inventors. Startups. Established businesses. Architects. Attorneys. We work with a wide variety of
people who need help solving a problem.

## How much do your services usually cost?

There’s a wide range of costs but here are a few guidelines. For a simple product consisting of
fewer than 5 custom parts and no electronics, the cost is generally below $10,000. The more
complexity, the greater the investment. It can range from 10s of thousands to more than $100k (on
rare occasions). An initial consultation and quote is always free at Protobear.

## What locations do you serve?

While based in Denver, we serve clients across the US and the world.

Current Artec Eva and Eva Lite customers can now trade in and trade up with Rapid Scan 3D. For a

and a $750 cash trade-in bonus toward the purchase of an Artec Spider II or Artec Leo.

Capture] ][185]

#### [Artec Jet 3D Scanner: High-Speed SLAM LiDAR for Large-Scale 3D Mapping, Digital Twins, and
#### Reality Capture][186]

The Artec Jet is a high-speed SLAM LiDAR 3D scanner designed for large-scale reality capture,
digital twins, as-built documentation, infrastructure mapping, mining, inspection, and Scan-to-BIM
workflows. With flexible deployment options including handheld, backpack, drone, vehicle, robot,
cage, and telescopic pole mounting, Artec Jet helps capture accurate 3D data in large, complex, and
GPS-denied environments quickly and safely.
* [by Chris Strong][187]
* May 13, 2026

[
[Kreon 3D Scanning Arms for Quality Control Inspection] ][188]

#### [Kreon 3D Scanning Arms for Quality Control Inspection][189]

Kreon Ace scanning arms with Skyline laser scanners provide fast, portable quality control
inspection directly on the shop floor. Learn how Rapid Scan 3D helps manufacturers implement 3D
scanning arm inspection solutions using Geomagic and PolyWorks software for accurate CAD-to-part
verification.
* [by Chris Strong][190]
* April 21, 2026

[Improving Orthotics & Prosthetics Workflows with Modern 3D Scanning] ][191]

3D scanning is transforming orthotics and prosthetics by replacing traditional casting with faster,
cleaner, and more accurate digital workflows. Learn how scanners like the 3DeVOK MQ, iReal 2E, and
iReal M3 help clinics improve patient comfort, increase efficiency, and produce better-fitting
custom devices.

  ### X-ray Diffractometer crystal orientation instrument
  
  Raysov RSO30 series diffractometer orientation instrument series is specifically designed for
  semiconductor, photovoltaic, and precision manufacturing industries to provide reliable lattice
  orientation measurement solutions. The system adopts single diffraction/double diffraction
  technology, enabling rapid and precise crystal angle measurement, providing key data support for
  subsequent cutting, grinding, and other processes. With a high-sensitivity detection system and
  stable mechanical structure, orientation Instrument can accurately measure various samples such as
  crystal ingots, bars, and wafers.
  
  ][78]
* [
  [Industrial Spiral CT]
  
  ### Industrial Spiral CT
  
  Compared with conventional vertical industrial CT detection equipment and horizontal CT equipment
  based on object rotation, spiral CT employs a detection method where the test object to be
  examined is horizontally translated. During detection, the radiation source and detector move
  around the object under examination, while the object only requires translational motion.
  Industrial Spiral CT can complete scans in a shorter time, and the horizontal translation
  detection method can process larger samples, making it suitable for inspecting ultra-long test
  object. Meanwhile, the loading and unloading operations of spiral CT are more convenient,
  significantly improving detection efficiency and enabling rapid online detection. Spiral CT also
  avoids imaging motion artifacts caused by the movement of internal components of the object being
  examined, making it particularly suitable for online CT detection of long object.

## # About Us-Raysov Instrument Co.,Ltd.
## 
## ][76]

Established in 2009,RAYSOV Instrument Co., Ltd is a prominent manufacturer of advanced X-ray
non-destructive testing and evaluation instruments based in China , RAYSOV has earned reputation as
a high-end supplier of automated industrial DR and industrial CT inspection solutions globally.
RAYSOV places immense importance on meeting international standards, holding certifications such as
ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, IS027001, and other related certifications. These achievements
demonstrate the company's commitment to adhering to strict quality controls and maintaining
environmentally friendly practices.
[More][77]

## Products
* [
  [X-ray Diffractometer crystal orientation instrument]
  
  ### X-ray Diffractometer crystal orientation instrument
  
  Raysov RSO30 series diffractometer orientation instrument series is specifically designed for
  semiconductor, photovoltaic, and precision manufacturing industries to provide reliable lattice
  orientation measurement solutions. The system adopts single diffraction/double diffraction
  technology, enabling rapid and precise crystal angle measurement, providing key data support for
  subsequent cutting, grinding, and other processes. With a high-sensitivity detection system and
  stable mechanical structure, orientation Instrument can accurately measure various samples such as
  crystal ingots, bars, and wafers.
  
  ][78]
* [
  [Industrial Spiral CT]
  
  ### Industrial Spiral CT
  
  Compared with conventional vertical industrial CT detection equipment and horizontal CT equipment
  based on object rotation, spiral CT employs a detection method where the test object to be
  examined is horizontally translated. During detection, the radiation source and detector move
  around the object under examination, while the object only requires translational motion.
  Industrial Spiral CT can complete scans in a shorter time, and the horizontal translation
  detection method can process larger samples, making it suitable for inspecting ultra-long test
  object. Meanwhile, the loading and unloading operations of spiral CT are more convenient,
  significantly improving detection efficiency and enabling rapid online detection. Spiral CT also
  avoids imaging motion artifacts caused by the movement of internal components of the object being
  examined, making it particularly suitable for online CT detection of long object.
  
  ][79]
* [
  [High-freedom 5 axis industrial DR(Digital radiography) X-ray inspection systems RT solutions
  applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee D]
  
  ### High-freedom 5 axis industrial DR(Digital radiography) X-ray inspection systems RT solutions
  ### applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee D
  
  High-freedom 5 axis industrial DR(Digital radiography) X-ray inspection systems RT solutions
  applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee D Series is offline X-ray inspection system is a series of
  inspection solutions developed base on high-freedom tilt C-arm 5axis mechanism, specifically for
  quality control needs of castings (aluminum alloy, steel, resin, etc.) and small and medium-sized
  welded parts (Liquefied gas cylinders, high-voltage electrical enclosures, etc.), and different
  specifications and sizes objectsand engineered for durability, efficiency, and versatility in
  heavy-industry projects. Designed with advanced technology and robust materials, ensures superior
  match hard enviorment and high-precison requirement, smooth operation, and testing efficiency.
  Suitable for high-precision automatic applications, it delivers exceptional performance in diverse
  X-ray digital radiagraphy mode and working conditions,widely used in alloy casting, ceramic
  sintered part, welding, injection molding, and other manufacturer and research fields.
  
  ][80]
* [
  [ADR Automatic Defect Recognition Industrial Manipulator Customized X-ray Inspection Systems for
  NDT RT solutions applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee F]
  
  ### ADR Automatic Defect Recognition Industrial Manipulator Customized X-ray Inspection Systems
  ### for NDT RT solutions applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee F
  
  ADR Automatic Defect Recognition Industrial Manipulator Customized X-ray Inspection Systems for
  NDT RT solutions applications - RAYSOV ZXFlasee F Series is customize designed for complex special
  material parts, and engineered for durability, efficiency, and versatility in heavy-industry
  projects. Designed with advanced technology and robust materials, ensures superior match hard
  enviorment and high-precison requirement, smooth operation, and testing efficiency. Suitable for
  high-precision automatic applications, it delivers exceptional performance in diverse X-ray
  digital radiagraphy mode and working conditions,widely used in aviation, aerospace, science and
  defense field.
  
  ][81]
* [
  [X-ray Wheel Hub CT Scan Solutions]
  
  ### X-ray Wheel Hub CT Scan Solutions
  
  Nondestructive testing (NDT)for aluminum alloy wheel hub . Reconstructe the internal structure of
  wheel hub into three-dimensional model. Accurate location and size of defects, such as pores,
  shrinkage holes and other internal flaws. Reliability, and widespread adoption in various wheels
  quality control and failure analysis avoid potential risks. Optional Automated Defect Recognition
  (ADR) software.
  
  ][82]
* [
  [DR&CT Laboratory Services]
  
  ### DR&CT Laboratory Services
  
  Nondestructive testing (NDT) . Fast and directly display object internal structure and defects

  ][83]

# We make it real.

Create detailed 3D models from images and laser scans with ease. Our photogrammetry solution makes
it simple for anyone to turn their surroundings into astounding digital replicas.

The RealityCapture legacy licensing server will close down on August 3

RealityScan 2.1 is now available

][6]The latest release of RealityScan brings powerful automation and advanced LiDAR capabilities,
including the ability to import SLAM data and point clouds with classification. Download it today.
RealityScan Mobile

## Bring objects to life in 3D using your phone.

Turn your phone into a powerful 3D scanning tool and bring the real world into digital space. With
RealityScan Mobile, you can capture, process, and share high-fidelity scans effortlessly, all from
your mobile device.
[Learn more][7]

## Ready for any challenge.

Capture your surroundings. Scan objects. Preserve artifacts. Recreate reality in stunning detail and
transform real-world objects into immersive digital environments. No matter the industry, scale, or
purpose, RealityScan provides the tools to turn the physical world into high-quality digital assets
with speed and precision.

Turn reality into stunning digital replicas, reconstruct entire environments, and create assets from
real-world objects. With RealityScan, you have the freedom to effortlessly transform the physical
world into high-quality digital models. We continue to push the boundaries of photogrammetry,
ensuring that you are the one who defines the limits of what’s possible.
[See all features][13]

## Install RealityScan on desktop

[Download instructions][14]

Step 1

Download the launcher

Before you can install and run RealityScan, you’ll need to download and install the Epic Games
launcher.

Download launcher

Step 2

Install Epic Games launcher

Once downloaded and installed, [open the launcher][15] and create or log in to your Epic Games
account.

[Get support][16], or restart your Epic Games launcher download in Step 1.

Step 3

Install RealityScan

Once logged in, navigate to the RealityScan tab in the Unreal Engine section and click the install
button to download the most recent version.

Looking for RealityScan Mobile?

Grab your phone and start scanning.

[RealityScan Mobile][17]

## Get started in RealityScan

New to photogrammetry? Switching from another tool? No matter your background, we have everything
you need to get started—tutorials, guides, samples, documentation, and more to help you master

## About Us

We provide [Scan to CAD][31] and [Scan to BIM][32] modeling services and successfully deliver more
than 300 projects every year, accurately converting [Point Cloud into 3D BIM][33] and 2D CAD
drawings, including high-detail [Revit MEP projects up to LOD500][34]. Rvtcad has earned a
reputation in the field of 3D Laser Scanning As-Built services, catering to leading solo surveyors,
3D laser scanning companies, architects, AutoCAD and Revit experts, building surveyors, engineers,
property owners, contractors, and BIM Freelancers. We have a strong presence in the process of
creating an accurate As-built CAD and BIM model by using Point cloud data, generated from 3D laser
scanning machines such as [Faro][35], Leica, Matterport, Navvis, Trimble, Geoslam, etc which enables
our in-depth experience and specialization in providing end-to-end BIM services worldwide.

What you can get

## The deliverable is the point, not the scan.

We measure what already exists, then hand you the drawing or model your team designs and builds
against. Pick the one that fits your work.

### 2D as-built drawings and floor plans

Plans, elevations, and sections with real window and door sizes. The existing-conditions record most
renovation and residential work actually needs.

### 3D and Revit models

Scan-to-BIM models that drop into Revit or CAD, built to the level of detail your workflow calls
for.

### Matterport walkthroughs

A virtual walk of the space you can share with anyone. Walk the site from your desk instead of
driving back to it.

### Point cloud data

The raw measured capture, registered and cleaned, ready for your own team to model or measure
against.

### Sites and land

Drone and topographic capture for exteriors, roofs, acreage, and terrain, turned into site models
and surfaces.

### Objects and parts

Close-range capture of parts, fixtures, and components so fabricators can build to the real
geometry.

Not sure which one your project needs? That is our job, not yours. [Tell us the project][19] and we
sort the deliverable.

Real jobs we capture

## Scan what exists, so what you build fits the first time.

You get exact dimensions to design against. No re-measuring, no misfits, no second trip to the site.

### A commercial property going up for sale

We scanned a printing shop in about 45 minutes. The seller, the agent, and the buyer's architect all
worked from the same existing-conditions capture to plan and market what the space becomes next.

### A custom handrail built to fit a stair

Metal or hand-carved wood, a railing has to land on an existing stair exactly. Scan the stair, hand
the fabricator the geometry, and it drops in without cutting and refitting on site.

### A renovation tying into existing walls

An addition has to meet what is already there. We capture the existing structure so the new design
connects clean, instead of finding the walls are off by inches once framing starts.

### An old building with no drawings

When the original plans are long gone, we capture what is physically there and give you an accurate
as-built to design from, whether it is a historic theater or a working plant.

What you can get

## The deliverable is the point, not the scan.

We measure what already exists, then hand you the drawing or model your team designs and builds
against. Pick the one that fits your work.

### 2D as-built drawings and floor plans

Plans, elevations, and sections with real window and door sizes. The existing-conditions record most
renovation and residential work actually needs.

### 3D and Revit models

Scan-to-BIM models that drop into Revit or CAD, built to the level of detail your workflow calls
for.

### Matterport walkthroughs

A virtual walk of the space you can share with anyone. Walk the site from your desk instead of
driving back to it.

### Point cloud data

The raw measured capture, registered and cleaned, ready for your own team to model or measure
against.

### Sites and land

Drone and topographic capture for exteriors, roofs, acreage, and terrain, turned into site models
and surfaces.

### Objects and parts

Close-range capture of parts, fixtures, and components so fabricators can build to the real
geometry.

Not sure which one your project needs? That is our job, not yours. [Tell us the project][19] and we
sort the deliverable.

Real jobs we capture

## Scan what exists, so what you build fits the first time.

You get exact dimensions to design against. No re-measuring, no misfits, no second trip to the site.

### A commercial property going up for sale

We scanned a printing shop in about 45 minutes. The seller, the agent, and the buyer's architect all
worked from the same existing-conditions capture to plan and market what the space becomes next.

### A custom handrail built to fit a stair

Metal or hand-carved wood, a railing has to land on an existing stair exactly. Scan the stair, hand
the fabricator the geometry, and it drops in without cutting and refitting on site.

### A renovation tying into existing walls

An addition has to meet what is already there. We capture the existing structure so the new design
connects clean, instead of finding the walls are off by inches once framing starts.

### An old building with no drawings

When the original plans are long gone, we capture what is physically there and give you an accurate
as-built to design from, whether it is a historic theater or a working plant.

##### AutoQuote3D

Ultimate auto quoting and print management system that is seamless, efficient, and cost-effective,
and can be deployed to your website within an hour.

][245]
[

##### Shining3D ExModel Pro

Provides a comprehensive set of tools to seamlessly convert a 3D scan into a professional quality
CAD model in easy steps using Shining3D Scanners.

][246]
[

##### Formlabs Open Material

Open Materials Licenses (OML) for Formlabs resin printers. Unlocks best-in-class third-party resins,
custom print settings for tailored print performance, or the ability to experiment with any 405 nm
photopolymer resin.

][247]
[

##### RiiForm Socket Fitting Software

riiForm is a web-based platform designed to enhance and simplify your socket fitting process using
extensive historical data.

][248]

us handle the printing while your concepts take shape.

][250]

###### Training

][251]

###### Maintenance


Get ahead of costly repairs due to preventable wear and tear with our comprehensive cleaning and
tune-up maintenance packages.


][252]

###### Warranty Options


Get peace of mind for your investment with rock-solid warranty options directly from the
manufacturer.

][253]

Engineering, Reproductions, Archival, and VR/Game assets.

your questions or explore your specific use case.

###### PROFESSIONAL 3D SCANNERS & HIGH-RESOLUTION SHAPE DIGITIZERS

SMARTTECH3D company is a well-known expert in the 3D Measurement industry. Set up in 2000 we gained
a leading position in the European region, becoming one of the most famous Polish innovation brands,
gaining the name of Polish Product of the Future. Our MICRON 3D and SMARTTECH 3D systems have won a
gold medal at the 36th International Exhibition of Inventions in Geneva and 55th World Exhibition on
Innovation, Research and New Technologies in "Brussels EUREKA 2006".

[Read more about company][54]

INDUSTRY


[Go to ][55]

The most innovative organizations – from automotive, industrial machinery, aerospace and defense to
footwear, sporting goods, consumer goods and consumer electronics, – rely on 3D scanning throughout
the product design and development process.

MUSEOLOGY AND ARCHEOLOGY

[Go to ][56]

The highest resolution color 3D scanning, the best accuracy texture scanning, and non-contact
measurement makes SMARTTECH 3D’s scanners an ideal tool for heritage preservation and museum
purposes.

MEDICINE


[Go to ][57]

3D scanning has wide use in medicine. It provides non-contact human body measurements to analyze the
posture for prosthetics and high-resolution scans used during plastic surgery.


#### SMARTTECH3Dmeasure  - DEDICATED SOFTWARE

[[control summary.png]][58]

[SMARTTECH3Dmeasure][59] is a user-friendly, advanced control and post-processing software dedicated
to acquiring data obtained from all models of SMARTTECHs’ 3D scanners and post-processing for RE
processes, digitalization with color and quality control. This software is a perfect multi-tool for
anyone starting work with optical scanning without additional investment, no matter if you are an
engineer or an archeologist. [Read More...][60]

INDUSTRY

[Go to ][56]

MEDICINE


[Go to ][57]

3D scanning has wide use in medicine. It provides non-contact human body measurements to analyze the
posture for prosthetics and high-resolution scans used during plastic surgery.

# THE HOME OF NATIONAL TEAM FAN TOKENS™.

Back your nation with Fan Tokens™ and experience the tournament on Socios.com. Trade Fan Tokens™,
join matchday Token Hunts, compete with fellow fans and earn rewards throughout the tournament.

**Featuring official Fan Tokens™ from Argentina, Portugal, Belgium, South Africa and Scotland.**

[ Get Started ][29]
[ Download app ][30]

# the home of
# fan tokens.

Download the official Fan Token™ Wallet today! Hold, stake and trade Fan Tokens™, access Web3 sports
platforms & earn rewards from 70+ elite sports teams.
[Get Started][31] [Download app ][32]

## 70+ teams. 1 app.

The home of fan engagement and rewards for the world’s biggest teams.
[ Find your team ][33]

##  Your journey to incredible rewards

Transform your passion into rewards with officially licensed Fan Tokens.
Socios.com is a free-to-register Fan Engagement and Rewards app. But your journey ignites with Fan
Tokens. Get unprecedented access to your team, engage, earn points, and reward your passion with the
world’s best Fan Rewards. No renewal is required. 

## How it works

Join The Community
Register online, or download the app. Opening your Socios.com wallet takes just minutes.
Get Fan Tokens
Add Fan Tokens to your wallet. 
Engage
Use Fan Tokens to engage with the features on Socios.com and earn Reward Points. 
Redeem Rewards
Reward Points unlock the best fan rewards in the world.
[ Learn More ][34]

## The world’s best
## fan rewards

Watch a match alongside legends. Fly with the team on an away trip.
Score in iconic stadiums. Own game-scored balls and more (much more).
Premium
Access unmatched experiences that go beyond the pitch
Tickets
Get unparalleled access to major sporting events.
Merchandise
Gear up with authentic team merchandise.
Collectibles
Own Game-Scored Balls, Matchworn Shirts, Digital Collectibles, and More.

## Real Fans.
## Unreal Stories.

This is no fantasy game. Socios.com is real fans making a real impact and getting rewarded with
unreal experiences.
“Thank you Socios.com for my Ruben Dias signed shirt. I am absolutely thrilled.”

#### Bertie, UK

Man City Fan Token Holder
"It was the most special day of my life. I was so excited! Thank you Socios.com."

#### Nabe, Japan

AS Roma Fan Token Holder
"Still speechless after my “Live the dream” experience !!! Thank you socios.com. It has been
something that I’ll always bring in my heart!"

#### Fabrizio, Italy

AC Milan Fan Token Holder
"The last two days have been a dream. Still can't believe what I've experienced. It doesn't feel
real. Juventus doesn't come here often, but thanks to Socios.com, I was able to take this experience
to the next level. I'm forever thankful."

#### Martina, USA

Juventus Fan Token Holder
"Thank you for such a wonderful night. Result was unfortunate but it did not put me down. I had my
expectations high but they were still absolutely smashed. Red carpets, gold elevators, amazing food
and drinks, players families.. was truly a VIP experience."

#### Rian, Ireland

FC Barcelona Fan Token Holder
“This is the biggest benefit and I'm not talking just about the tickets. I saw my team become
Brazilian Champion for the first time in 50 years. There's no price on this opportunity I had thanks
to Socios.com"

#### Paulo, Brazil

Atletico Fan Token Holder

## Own Your Passion.

## Reap The Rewards.

# Meet the Structure Sensor 3

## Scan anything into 3D.

[ Discover Structure Sensor 3 Discover ][49]

## Our Mission

Translating personalized body data into simple, powerful tools.

[About Us][50]

## How It Works

## 3D Scanning Technology Built for Healthcare and Industry

Structure builds professional-grade 3D scanning hardware and software for medical, clinical, and
industrial applications. Our flagship product, the [Structure Sensor 3][51], attaches to any
compatible iPad to deliver millimeter depth accuracy — enabling clinicians, prosthetists,
orthotists, and developers to capture precise body measurements in seconds.

Healthcare providers trust Structure technology across a wide range of clinical workflows: custom
orthotic and prosthetic fitting, wound measurement, surgical planning, and patient monitoring. The
[Structure Capture app][52] — compatible with iPhone TrueDepth cameras, iPad LiDAR, and all
Structure Sensor hardware — lets any care team member capture publication-quality 3D scans without
specialized training.

Developers building depth-sensing applications use the [Structure SDK][53] to integrate Structure
Sensor 3 directly into iOS apps, with access to raw depth frames, mesh extraction, foot measurement,
and offline licensing. The SDK powers hundreds of apps across healthcare, industrial inspection,
retail fit-tech, and augmented reality.

Structure is based in Boulder, Colorado, and serves customers in over 50 countries. Our sensors are
used in peer-reviewed clinical research, FDA-cleared workflows, and enterprise scanning deployments
worldwide. [Read our customer case studies][54] to see how organizations like [Medi][55], [Rise
Bionics][56], and [Bath Fitter][57] use Structure technology to improve patient outcomes and
business results.

# Meet the Structure Sensor 3

## Scan anything into 3D.

[ Discover Structure Sensor 3 Discover ][49]

## Our Mission

Translating personalized body data into simple, powerful tools.

[About Us][50]

## How It Works

## 3D Scanning Technology Built for Healthcare and Industry

Structure builds professional-grade 3D scanning hardware and software for medical, clinical, and
industrial applications. Our flagship product, the [Structure Sensor 3][51], attaches to any
compatible iPad to deliver millimeter depth accuracy — enabling clinicians, prosthetists,
orthotists, and developers to capture precise body measurements in seconds.

Healthcare providers trust Structure technology across a wide range of clinical workflows: custom
orthotic and prosthetic fitting, wound measurement, surgical planning, and patient monitoring. The
[Structure Capture app][52] — compatible with iPhone TrueDepth cameras, iPad LiDAR, and all
Structure Sensor hardware — lets any care team member capture publication-quality 3D scans without
specialized training.

Developers building depth-sensing applications use the [Structure SDK][53] to integrate Structure
Sensor 3 directly into iOS apps, with access to raw depth frames, mesh extraction, foot measurement,
and offline licensing. The SDK powers hundreds of apps across healthcare, industrial inspection,
retail fit-tech, and augmented reality.

Structure is based in Boulder, Colorado, and serves customers in over 50 countries. Our sensors are
used in peer-reviewed clinical research, FDA-cleared workflows, and enterprise scanning deployments
worldwide. [Read our customer case studies][54] to see how organizations like [Medi][55], [Rise
Bionics][56], and [Bath Fitter][57] use Structure technology to improve patient outcomes and
business results.

escalate.

Eliminate blind spots by continuously discovering assets across your modern IT environment. Use
risk-based prioritization to focus your team on the vulnerabilities that attackers are most likely
to exploit first.

###### HOW WE DO IT

## FDM

[DSCF9214.JPG]

Fused Deposition Modeling, or FDM for short, refers to the most common method of 3D Printing, where
material is deposited in layers via an extruding system.


These 3D printers have the largest range of accessible filament-based materials, and feature a few
color options.  FDM 3D printers are generally the most economical printing solution for early
prototypes and practical-use parts.


* Wide Range of Material & Color Options
* Strongest Available Parts
* Lowest Cost of Entry
* 3D Printed Pieces typically have visible layer lines without additional post-processing

## SLA

[INDUSTRIAL SLA.jpg]

Stereolithography 3D Printing, otherwise known as SLA, is an tried and true method of 3D printing
that uses lasers to draw parts from a batch of liquid photopolymer resin.


Rather than deposit material like FDM, an SLA 3D Printer bonds each layer of material to the
previous, allowing for microscopic levels of detail with virtually invisible layer lines.
Stereolithography 3D printing makes up the majority of the 3D printing we do thanks to its large
build volume and smooth finish.


* Smooth and High-Detail printing makes this ideal for artistic applications including sculptures,
  mold masters, and prop production
* Clear, Elastic, Wax and Durable end-use materials are available at smaller volume
* Perfect for casting jewelry and making detailed models that readily accept paint applications


## MJF

[nylon powder.jpg]

Multijet Fusion 3D Printing (MJF)

is a powder-based method of 3D printing where layers of powder are selectively cured with a
combination of binding fluid and heat, to anneal into tough, tensile, and complex functional parts.


At this time, we only print with Nylon PA11 Powder. An impact-resistant functional print material
with a fine surface finish compared to the more common PA12. PA11 is derived primarily from castor
beans.

* Exceptional tensile strength
* High wear and fatigue resistance
* Ideal for functional prototypes and production parts (strong enough for real-world applications
  and testing)
* Great for gears, hinges, brackets, enclosures, and more...

###### HOW WE DO IT

## FDM

[DSCF9214.JPG]

Fused Deposition Modeling, or FDM for short, refers to the most common method of 3D Printing, where
material is deposited in layers via an extruding system.


These 3D printers have the largest range of accessible filament-based materials, and feature a few
color options.  FDM 3D printers are generally the most economical printing solution for early
prototypes and practical-use parts.


* Wide Range of Material & Color Options
* Strongest Available Parts
* Lowest Cost of Entry
* 3D Printed Pieces typically have visible layer lines without additional post-processing

## SLA

[INDUSTRIAL SLA.jpg]

Stereolithography 3D Printing, otherwise known as SLA, is an tried and true method of 3D printing
that uses lasers to draw parts from a batch of liquid photopolymer resin.


Rather than deposit material like FDM, an SLA 3D Printer bonds each layer of material to the
previous, allowing for microscopic levels of detail with virtually invisible layer lines.
Stereolithography 3D printing makes up the majority of the 3D printing we do thanks to its large
build volume and smooth finish.


* Smooth and High-Detail printing makes this ideal for artistic applications including sculptures,
  mold masters, and prop production
* Clear, Elastic, Wax and Durable end-use materials are available at smaller volume
* Perfect for casting jewelry and making detailed models that readily accept paint applications


## MJF

[nylon powder.jpg]

Multijet Fusion 3D Printing (MJF)

is a powder-based method of 3D printing where layers of powder are selectively cured with a
combination of binding fluid and heat, to anneal into tough, tensile, and complex functional parts.


At this time, we only print with Nylon PA11 Powder. An impact-resistant functional print material
with a fine surface finish compared to the more common PA12. PA11 is derived primarily from castor
beans.

* Exceptional tensile strength
* High wear and fatigue resistance

technologies, processes, vendors, know-how and lot of capital. Many young innovators and MSMEs get
overwhelmed by the complexity involved and drop off mid way. At THINK3D, we address this shortcoming
by offering one-stop solution for all product development needs. We are a digital native
manufacturing firm providing seamless experience to the next-gen innovators in their product
development journey. In other words, we **“enable innovation in India” **through low volume
production.
